plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-prompt-drift

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

System-prompt surface drift gate for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).

Any plugin or preset can contribute sections to the assembled system prompt.
Upgrading one can silently rewrite what the model is **told**; a malicious
one can inject "ignore all safety rules" straight into the prompt. This
plugin hooks the `system-prompt/assemble` waterfall, hashes every section
(name → sha256(text)), baselines the surface, and diffs every later
assembly against it. **dsh-mcp-test guards what the model can call; this
guards what the model is told.** Zero LLM calls in the trust path.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

Empty lane. The nearest neighbour (`dsh-modelprint`, 0★) fingerprints model
config, not the prompt surface. Prompt-injection plugins scan *content
flowing in*; nobody watches the assembled prompt itself — the one channel
every plugin can write to without anyone reviewing a diff.

## How it works

```
system-prompt/assemble ──> sections [{name, sha256(text)}] name-sorted
                     ──> baseline absent? freeze it (commit the file)
                     ──> diff: added / removed / changed sections
                     ──> warn once per distinct drift (signature dedup)
```

Dynamic sections (cwd, timestamps) can be excluded via `ignoreSections`.
Baseline file is stable, name-sorted JSON — commit it; it is the contract.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift
```

Prebuilt `lib/` ships in the repo — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization.

## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-prompt-drift
  name: dsh-prompt-drift
  config:
    baselinePath: .dsh-prompt-drift/baseline.json
    rebaselineOnDrift: false
    ignoreSections: []
```

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-prompt-drift] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-prompt-drift` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install && npm test
```

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party prompt-surface pinning, this freezes at its last
working version with a postmortem here.

plugins.description: Live status badge + non-interrupting in-flight guidance for DeepSeek Harness · DSH 会话头实时状态徽标 + 运行中指导（不打断，支持图片附件与插话历史）
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-steer 中文 | [English](#english) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：在会话头放一个实时状态徽标，并允许你在 Agent 干活的中途补一句、纠一句，而不用打断它。 Agent 跑长任务时有两个具体的麻烦。第一，你不知道它此刻在做什么——「等待响应」和「真的卡住」看起来一模一样。第二，你发现方向不对时，只能等它做完，或者直接打断，没有中间选项。这个插件分别解决这两件事。 ![会话头实时状态徽标 + 运行中指导浮层（真机截图）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-1-runtime-and-guidance.png) ## 快速开始 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` 装完重启应用（`bundles` 只在启动时读一次）。之后会话头右上角会出现状态徽标和「指导」按钮。 桌面版（DeepSeek Harness.app）独占管理自己的 profile，需要用应用自带的 CLI： ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` ## 状态徽标 徽标只显示当前阶段，按发生的顺序推进：分析中 → 思考中 · 本步 N 字 → 输出中 · 本步 N 字 → 运行 <工具> → 读取工具结果，收尾回到「工作中」。工具阶段后面跟一句命令摘要，例如「运行 bash · Run route probes」。 有两处刻意的取舍。字数是按步统计的——每个 turn/step 边界重新计数，而不是整段会话的累计值，后者最终只会变成一个越来越大的无意义数字。徽标也不显示模型名，模型、provider、上下文窗口和步号（`T4·S3`）都放在点开的详情面板里，徽标本身保持安静。 耗时秒数由客户端本地时钟计算，host 只发时间戳，所以空闲时没有定时器，也不会每秒推一次 SSE。 状态不猜。没有新进展时显示「暂无新增量」，实时源断开时显示「状态实时源断开」，而不是继续挂着上一次的阶段。请求失败只显示官方返回的 `failure.code`；只有 `llm/retry` 真的触发才显示重试，不写「可能是网络问题」这种无法证明的话。 ![点开徽标：运行状态诊断面板（阶段、步号 T4·S1、语言切换）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-3-runtime-detail.png) ## 运行中指导 这是插件的主要能力。你写一句话，它会在当前回合内、最近一次小步（一次推理或一次工具调用）结束的边界被读进上下文，任务继续往下跑——不打断、不重开、不等整轮结束。 实现上用自定义消息 kind（`source.kind` 为 `dsh-steer`）加 `agent.steer()`。这一点是关键：如果按普通用户消息投递，模型会把它当成一条新任务，表现就是打断当前工作。 指导框支持直接贴图或选文件，附件经宿主的 `attachments` 服务落成持久引用。输入框按会话保存草稿，刷新不丢。 浮层里会列出本次会话发出的插话，每条标出它的归宿： - ✓ 已读取，并标出在第几轮第几步被读到，例如 `T7·S3` - · 已送达，还没被读 - ✗ 未读取，回合已结束或消息被丢弃 点任意一条可以把原文回填到输入框；未读取的可以一键重发，重发会带上原来的附件，不需要重新上传。历史只收本插件发出的插话，主对话框里的聊天记录不算。 ![指导浮层：插话历史标出在第几轮第几步被读取（✓ T1·S2）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-2-guidance-history.png) 界面语言在详情面板里切换，可选自动、中文、English。选择写在 `~/.dsh/dsh-steer.lang`，不使用 localStorage。 ## 为什么不提供排队和官方插话 官方的 queue 和 steer 本质上都是「以用户身份发一条消息」——对话框本来就能发，官方队列栏本来就能排队。所以 v0.1.0 把这两条通道删掉了，插件只保留上面那条不打断的投递。 ## 数据通道 | 路由 | 用途 | |---|---| | `GET /dsh-steer/state?session=` | SSE 实时快照，仅状态变化时推送 | | `POST /dsh-steer/steer` | 运行中指导。请求体为 `{sessionId, text?, attachments?, reuseAtts?}`，其中 `reuseAtts` 用于重发时复用已有附件，不重传字节 | | `GET /dsh-steer/attachment?session=&id=[&raw=1]` | 读取指导附件，`raw=1` 时直接回字节流 | | `GET\|POST /dsh-steer/lang` | 界面语言，取值 `auto`、`zh`、`en` | | `GET /dsh-steer/ping` | 健康检查 | 出错时返回稳定的错误码：`mode-removed`（400）、`no-live-agent`（409）、`missing sessionId or content`（400）、`payload too large`（413）、`no-attachments` 与 `no-attachment-api`（501）、`reuse-attachment-unreadable`（404）。客户端按语言把这些码映射成提示文案，界面不会直接显示中文原文。 ## 安全 插件不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai` 包，只使用 `ctx.agents` 与 `ctx.webServer` 两个公开服务，另外可选地取用 `attachments` 和 `sessionController`。所有路由只接受 loopback 地址（127.0.0.1 与 ::1），没有遥测，也没有对外网络请求。 请求体分两档限制：纯文字 3 KB，带附件 48 MB——上限先按宿主 `imageLimits` 计算，再封顶，避免宿主报出的 200 MB 上限把内存撑爆。附件字节只通过官方 `sessionController.attachment` 读回，该方法会校验该附件确实属于目标会话日志。 ## 测试 ```bash npm test ``` 38 个用例，覆盖状态机（含步切换归零）、附件链路（含宿主不支持时的 501 分支）、路由错误码、语言处理，以及客户端的纯显示逻辑。零依赖，跑在 `node --test` 上。 ## 刻意不做的事 这个插件的核心只有一件事：工作中途加一条指令。因此排队与改撤排队消息、投递模式、子代理进度、token 面板、可配置阈值、localStorage 都不做。 ## 许可证 MIT © 2026 Lyon --- # English [中文](#dsh-steer) | English A DeepSeek Harness plugin: a live status badge in the session header, plus a way to add or correct an instruction while the agent is working, without interrupting it. Long agent runs cause two specific problems. First, you cannot tell what the agent is doing right now — "waiting for a response" and "genuinely stuck" look identical. Second, when you notice the direction is wrong, your only options are to wait for the whole turn or to interrupt it. There is nothing in between. This plugin addresses both. ![Live status badge in the session header with the guidance popover open (real capture)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-1-runtime-and-guidance.png) ## Quick start ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` Restart the app afterwards (`bundles` are read once at startup). The status badge and a "Guide" button then appear in the session header. The desktop app (DeepSeek Harness.app) manages its profile exclusively, so use the CLI carrier that ships with it: ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" \ plugin --profile desktop add github:lyonleeeee/dsh-steer ``` ## The status badge The badge shows one phase at a time and advances in order: Analyzing → Thinking · N chars this step → Writing · N chars → Running → Reading tool result, then back to Working. During a tool call it appends a short summary, for example "Running bash · Run route probes". Two deliberate trade-offs. Character counts are per step — they reset at every turn/step boundary instead of accumulating over the whole stream, which only ever produced a meaningless growing number. The badge also omits the model name; model, provider, context window and step (`T4·S3`) live in the popover, so the badge itself stays quiet. Elapsed time is computed by a local clock in the client — the host only sends timestamps — so there is no timer while idle and no SSE push every second. The badge does not guess. With no new progress it shows "no new progress"; if the live source drops it shows "live source disconnected" rather than keeping a stale phase on screen. A failed request shows the official `failure.code`; a retry appears only when `llm/retry` actually fires, never as a guess about the network. ![Clicking the badge: the runtime detail panel (phase, step T4·S1, language switch)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-3-runtime-detail.png) ## In-flight guidance This is the plugin's main capability. You write a sentence, and it is read into context inside the current turn, at the end of the nearest small step (one reasoning block or one tool call). The task keeps running: no interrupt, no restart, no waiting for the turn to finish. It works through a custom message kind (`source.kind` is `dsh-steer`) plus `agent.steer()`. That detail matters. Delivered as an ordinary user message, the model would treat it as a new task — which is exactly what an interruption looks like. The guidance box accepts pasted images and selected files; attachments are committed as durable references through the host's `attachments` service. Drafts are stored per session, so a refresh does not lose them. The popover lists the guidance sent in this session, each entry marked with where it ended up: - ✓ read, with the turn and step where it was consumed, for example `T7·S3` - · delivered, not read yet - ✗ not read — the turn ended, or the message was discarded Click any entry to put its text back in the input. Entries that were never read can be resent in one click, and the resend carries the original attachments instead of uploading them again. The list only contains guidance sent from this plugin; messages from the main composer are not included. ![The guidance popover: history marks the turn and step where each entry was read (✓ T1·S2)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lyonleeeee/dsh-steer/HEAD/assets/screenshot-2-guidance-history.png) The UI language switches in the detail popover: Auto, 中文 or English. The choice is stored in `~/.dsh/dsh-steer.lang`; localStorage is not used. ## Why there is no queue and no official steer The official queue and steer are both just "send a message as the user" — the composer already does that, and the official queue bar already queues. v0.1.0 removed both channels, leaving only the non-interrupting delivery described above. ## Data channels | Route | Purpose | |---|---| | `GET /dsh-steer/state?session=` | SSE live snapshot, pushed on change only | | `POST /dsh-steer/steer` | In-flight guidance. Body: `{sessionId, text?, attachments?, reuseAtts?}`; `reuseAtts` reuses existing attachments when resending, without re-uploading | | `GET /dsh-steer/attachment?session=&id=[&r

plugins.description: Reliably push a local folder to GitHub: per-command proxy injection, self-healing gh auth, pre-push secret gate, and SHA read-back verification. Zero dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
# outbox

> 把本地目录可靠地送上 GitHub。一句话，不翻车。

[English abstract](#english-abstract) · MIT

`outbox` 把「推送」从一个每次都要现场拼命令的临时动作，变成一条**确定性的流水线**：

```
代理自动探测 → gh 登录态自愈 → 推送前安全闸门 → 建仓 / 提交 / 推送 → 远端 SHA 回读校验
```

**一份内核，三种用法**：命令行、任何 Agent（读 `SKILL.md`）、DeepSeek Harness 插件（`dsh-github-push`）。
三种外壳共用同一份代码，不存在「插件和 CLI 行为不一致」的问题。

---

## 它到底解决了什么

推送失败几乎从来不是因为 `git push` 写错了，而是因为**周围那些没人管的事**。下面是真实踩过的坑，以及 outbox 的处理方式：

| 真实故障 | 为什么会发生 | outbox 怎么处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `gh` 突然报「未登录」，可 `git push` 明明好好的 | gh 把登录态存在自己的 `hosts.yml` 里，该文件会因版本升级/配置迁移被清空；但 token 一直躺在系统凭据管理器里 | 检测到未登录时，从凭据管理器取出 token 自动灌回 gh，并**重新校验** |
| 网络时通时不通、推送卡死 | 环境变量里的代理并不是每条调用链都带着；代理关掉后变量还指着死端口 | 每次先探测端口，通则**按次注入**代理、不通则只清掉指向该端口的陈旧变量后直连 |
| 推着推着要输密码，挂在半路 | git 交互式询问 | 子进程一律置 `GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0`，宁可清清楚楚失败，也不静默挂起 |
| 密钥被推上公开仓库 | 没人会在推送前逐行看 diff | 推送前扫描**即将提交的索引**，命中高危内容直接阻断 |
| 命令返回 0，但推的是旧东西 | 退出码不等于结果 | 推送后回读远端分支，**要求远端 SHA 严格等于本地 HEAD** 才算成功 |
| 仓库里写死了本机用户目录的绝对路径 | 无意识泄露身份 | 扫描绝对路径中的用户名、身份证号、手机号等，命中后**禁止自动公开** |

---

## 安装

零依赖，只要 Node ≥ 18。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/<your-account>/outbox.git
cd outbox
node src/cli.mjs --help
```

## 用法

```bash
# 先看一眼会发生什么（只做预检，不提交不推送）
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility private --dry-run

# 发布到私有仓库（仓库不存在会自动创建）
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility private --description "我的项目"

# 明确要开源时才用 public
node src/cli.mjs --dir ./my-project --visibility public
```

常用选项：

| 选项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `--dir <路径>` | 要发布的目录（默认当前目录） |
| `--name <仓库名>` | 远端仓库名（默认由目录名规整而来） |
| `--visibility <值>` | `public` / `private` / `ask`（默认 `ask`） |
| `--proxy <值>` | `auto` / `off` / `http://host:port`（默认 `auto`，探测 7890） |
| `--proxy-port <端口>` | 代理探测端口，默认 `7890` |
| `--dry-run` | 只做预检 |
| `--json` | 结构化输出，便于脚本与 Agent 消费 |

退出码：`0` 成功 · `1` 出错 · `2` 预检阻断 · `3` 需要你先做决定

## 安全闸门

扫描的对象是**索引**（`git ls-files --cached`），也就是真正会被推上去的东西——因此 `.gitignore` 覆盖的文件天然不会被误报。

命中结果分三级：

| 级别 | 含义 | 行为 |
|---|---|---|
| `block` | 高置信度凭据：GitHub/OpenAI/AWS 令牌、私钥文件内容、`.env`/`*.pem`/`id_rsa` 等文件名、超过 95 MiB 的文件 | **硬阻断**，远端不会被创建 |
| `confirm` | 疑似个人敏感信息：身份证号、手机号、学号字段、暴露本机用户名的绝对路径，以及你自己的自定义模式 | **禁止自动公开**，必须逐条确认 |
| `warn` | 疑似明文口令/密钥赋值、超过 10 MiB 的大文件、**已被 gitignore 覆盖却仍在版本控制中的残留** | 只提示，不阻断 |

补充自定义模式：在 `~/.outbox/patterns.json` 写

```json
{ "confirm": [{ "id": "my-secret", "label": "我自己的敏感词", "pattern": "公司内部代号" }] }
```

### 放行清单

任何**带测试夹具的仓库**都会天然含有假密钥——测试扫描器就得放几个假 token 进去。没有出口的话，这种仓库会被自己的闸门拦住（outbox 第一次推送时，确实拦住了它自己）。

两种放行方式：

**仓库级**：在仓库根目录写 `.outboxallow`，每行一条：

```
# <路径 glob> [规则 id]
tests/selftest.mjs    github-token
tests/**/*.fixture.js
```

省略规则 id 表示放行该路径下的全部规则，但**建议永远写明确则 id**——放行范围越小越容易审计。这个文件本身会随仓库一起提交，所以「谁放行了什么」永远可查。

**行内**：在同一行写上 `outbox:allow`，该行的内容规则全部跳过。

被放行的命中不会凭空消失，而是记入结果的 `allowlisted` 字段，依旧可见。

## 设计取舍

**为什么代理不写进 git 全局配置？**
写全局最省事，但一旦代理软件关掉，本机**所有** git 操作（包括别的仓库）都会连不上。outbox 只在本次命令上用 `-c http.proxy=...` 注入，不留后遗症。

**为什么不用 `where.exe` 定位 git/gh？**
Windows 控制台工具按 OEM 代码页输出，而 Node 按 UTF-8 解码。只要可执行文件路径含中文（例如用户名是中文），解析结果就会变成一串替换字符，随后 `spawn` 报 `ENOENT`。更阴险的是 Git 常装在纯 ASCII 路径下所以一切正常——这个 bug 只在中文用户名的机器上爆发。正确做法是**把裸名字交给 Windows 自己按 PATH 解析**。

**为什么推送成功的判据是 SHA 而不是退出码？**
`git push` 返回 0 只代表命令没报错，不代表远端真的有你要的那个提交。回读 `git ls-remote` 拿到远端分支 SHA、与本地 `HEAD` 严格比对，才是可信证据。

**为什么安全闸门扫描索引而不是目录？**
索引就是「将要被推送的内容」，天然排除了忽略项，不会对 `.gitignore` 里的东西误报。

## 作为 Agent Skill 使用

`SKILL.md` 是给任意 Agent（Claude Code / Codex / DSH / 其它）读的说明书。把它放进你的技能目录，或直接贴进系统提示，Agent 就知道什么时候该调 `outbox`、什么时候必须先问用户。

## 相关项目

- **[`dsh-plugin/`](dsh-plugin/)** —— 同一份内核的 DSH 工具壳，注册模型工具 `github_push`，让「一句话推送」真正落地。源码就在本仓库里；它同时单独发布为一个 `dsh-github-push` 仓库，以便被 DSH 插件市场收录。两处的内核副本由 `scripts/sync-plugin.mjs` 机械同步，不存在第二份手写实现。
- [`dsh-plugin-publish`](https://github.com/suyukun/dsh-plugin-publish) —— 面向 Agent 技能的**发布流程协议**（preflight → 建仓 → awesome 列表 PR → 市场提交）。它是「说明书」，outbox 是「代码内核」，两者互补。

## English abstract

`outbox` reliably pushes a local folder to GitHub in a single command. It wraps the parts that actually break: auto-detecting a local proxy (default port 7890) and injecting it **per command** instead of globally, self-healing a `gh` login by recovering the token from the OS credential store, gating the push behind a secret/PII scan of the staged index, and verifying success by reading back the remote branch SHA instead of trusting an exit code. Zero dependencies, Node ≥ 18. One core, three shells: CLI, agent skill, and a DeepSeek Harness plugin.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: 节点式 GLSL 工作台（DSH / DeepSeek Harness 插件）：拖节点出图 → Shadertoy 兼容实时预览 → 热重载 → 本地材质资源管理（图片 / 音频 / 歌词）。可跨编译导出 HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V，支持导入 Shadertoy 源码。零第三方运行时依赖，8 个自带示例，169 个用例。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-shader-workbench [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-169%20passing-brightgreen.svg)](docs/开发与验证.md) [![dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-0-brightgreen.svg)](docs/开发与验证.md) **简体中文** · [English](README.en.md) **DSH Shader 工作台**：节点式搭 GLSL → Shadertoy 兼容实时预览 → 热重载 → 本地材质资源管理。 装在 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 里是一个侧栏入口 + 一整块工作台面板， 同时给 agent 开放 11 个工具，让它能直接建项目、搭节点图、编译、导出、打快照。 - **零第三方运行时依赖**：没有构建链，全是手写 ESM JavaScript，装上去就是一个目录。 - **节点图 = 程序**：内置节点库只放 **57 个通用件**；效果专用逻辑一律拆成图上能展开编辑的普通节点，不做黑盒。 - **重复是语言结构**：组的「重复次数」> 1 就是循环，循环体只写一遍（IFS 隧道 99 步、贝塞尔 24 段都靠它，图和着色器小两个数量级）。 - **可扩展、免重启**：用户节点丢个 JSON 进 `<工作区>/library/nodes/` 就能加；节点分类和项目名都支持多级。 - **撤销重做 + 分组注释**：快照式撤销栈（数量 + 字节双预算、同类操作自动合并），画布上能框选打组、写注释。 - **一份图，五个平台**：GLSL / HLSL / MSL / SPIR-V（`.spv` 二进制 + 人读 `.spvasm`）/ JSON bundle。 跨平台转译和 SPIR-V 二进制都是**自己写的**，不依赖任何外部 shader 工具链。 - **Shadertoy 直接搬**：贴一段 `mainImage()` 源码就变成一个可复用的用户节点；材质能打包成 ZIP 带走。 - **资源跟着材质走**：图片 / 音频 / 歌词统一进材质清单（`resources[]`，类型注册表可扩展）； 歌词是叠在画面上的 HTML 层，LRC 时间轴高亮，不占 shader。 - **面板和 agent 共用一套工具与工作区**：存储位置能在面板里改，两边看到的永远是同一份数据。 - **169 个用例**：含真机 WebGL2 编译校验、GPU 像素回读、真鼠标拖拽交互、1080p 性能度量、 跨平台转译的**逐点数值等价**验证。 ## 装上 ```bash cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop # package.json：dependencies 加 "dsh-shader-workbench": "file:<本仓库路径>" # dsh.profile.bundles 加 "dsh-shader-workbench" node install ``` 然后重启 DSH，侧栏会出现「Shader 工作台」。存储位置、配置项、加载排查见 [安装与配置](docs/安装与配置.md)。 ## 八个自带示例 面板资源树里点 **载入示例** 即可。**一个新节点都没加**，全部用现有组件搭出来。

IFS 隧道（Phantom Star 移植）
99 步累积 = 一个重复组，和原版逐像素一致
DFT 本轮画心形
每个旋转向量一个节点，轨迹靠 BufferA 反馈

9 抽样高斯模糊
双 Pass，半径可拖
三次贝塞尔
24 段采样是一个重复组，四个控制点可拖
另外四个（傅里叶级数 / 谐波频谱 / 景深 / FFT 音乐可视化）和每个示例的做法见 [示例说明](examples/README.md)。 ## 文档 | 文档 | 内容 | |---|---| | [安装与配置](docs/安装与配置.md) | 装上、存储位置与优先级、安全边界、加载排查 | | [使用手册](docs/使用手册.md) | 界面、画布操作与快捷键、节点库 57 个节点、11 个工具、工作区结构 | | [扩展指南](docs/扩展指南.md) | 加节点的三条路：用户节点 / 组与重复组 / 内置节点 | | [开发与验证](docs/开发与验证.md) | 开发命令、真机验证与实测性能、体积、本版没做的 | | [接口契约](docs/接口契约.md) | HTTP 动作、节点定义与代码生成契约（**改代码前先看这份**） | | [架构说明](docs/架构说明.md) | 分层、数据流、关键设计取舍与踩过的坑 | | [验收报告](docs/验收报告.md) | 各里程碑的真机验收记录 | | [示例说明](examples/README.md) | 8 个示例分别演示了什么、怎么搭的 | > 详细文档目前以中文为主；英文的 issue / PR 一样欢迎。 ## 仓库 - 仓库： - 问题反馈： - 许可：[MIT](LICENSE) --- 名字里的 "workbench" 是字面意思：它是个工作台，不是渲染引擎 —— 引擎只有 WebGL2，剩下的是「让你能一边连节点一边看画面」的那些东西。

plugins.description: Cross-project pinned Session groups for DeepSeek Harness Web (alpha preview)
plugins.readme_text: # DSH Session Groups DSH Session Groups 是一个独立安装的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件。在不修改 DSH 源码的前提下，它在原生 Workspace 项目树上方增加一个跨项目“置顶”区域，并允许用户把置顶 Session 整理到自定义分组中。 ## 预览状态 版本 `0.1.0` 已发布到公共 npm，用户只需安装 [@umialpha/dsh-session-groups](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@umialpha/dsh-session-groups)。四包下载完整性、全新 profile 的公开安装、启动、移除和官方 Workspace 恢复验证已通过。当前仍为 alpha 预览；真实鼠标拖入置顶、组间移动及拖放排序仍待验收，不作为已通过的浏览器能力宣传。 ![置顶与工作区同级显示的浅色预览](docs/screenshots/D-002-sidebar-light.jpg) ## 功能 - 保留官方 Workspace 的真实目录发现、项目树、搜索、原生置顶、Session 操作和导航行为。 - “置顶”和“工作区”作为同级区块显示；置顶整体可折叠，在搜索和列表模式中仍可见，不使用 tab，也不显示“未分组”标签。 - 空安装通过现有入口选择真实文件夹，不自动创建默认工作区目录；已有工作区和 Session 正常保留。 - 创建、重命名、删除、折叠和排序命名分组。 - 在默认层、组内和组间拖动 Session。 - 从任意项目直接拖入未置顶 Session；插件先调用原生置顶，再保存目标位置。 - 删除分组时只移除布局分组，成员仍保持置顶。 - 刷新或重启 DSH 后保留分组与顺序。 分组只是原生置顶集合的布局。它不会改变 Session 的项目归属、cwd 或项目内原生顺序，Session 仍显示在原项目中。 ## 兼容性 | 插件版本 | DeepSeek Harness | Cordis | |---|---|---| | `0.1.0` | `0.2.1-alpha.2` | `4.0.5-alpha.1` | 当前版本只支持表中的精确 DSH 版本。bundle 的 peer dependency 会在读取替换配置前拒绝不兼容版本，避免出现官方 Workspace 已停用但替代入口无法加载的半激活状态。 DSH 的 npm `latest` 当前为 `0.2.0-rc.2`，不在支持范围内；请显式使用上表 alpha 版本，不要只安装未指定版本的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`。 ## 安装 只安装 bundle；另外三个运行包会作为依赖自动安装： ```sh npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-alpha.2 dsh plugin --profile web add @umialpha/dsh-session-groups@0.1.0 --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ dsh web ``` 不需要修改 DSH 源码、profile YAML 或 Workspace 配置。安装命令显式使用 npm 官方源，避免镜像尚未同步新包时返回 404，不会修改全局 registry 配置。请打开本次 `dsh web` 输出的完整 URL；旧端口或缺少认证参数的 URL 可能显示 `dsh web authentication required`。 如果测试本仓库的开发版本，请先执行 `pnpm run build` 和安装 smoke；不要只链接 bundle 而遗漏另外三个 workspace 包。 本地安装 smoke 使用临时 `DSH_HOME` 和四包 tarball，只用于开发验证，不会把插件安装到你的日常 Web profile。 ## 使用 1. 继续使用原生“置顶”操作，或把项目树中的 Session 拖到顶部置顶区域。 2. 点击置顶标题右侧的新增按钮创建分组。 3. 拖动普通 Session、命名分组或组内 Session 调整布局。 4. 分组中的 Session 菜单可重命名、分叉、归档、移出分组或取消置顶。 blank Session 仍可打开，但没有时间、操作菜单或拖动能力。它在产生第一条内容并成为普通 Session 后恢复这些行为。 置顶整体折叠状态在当前页面内保留，刷新默认展开；分组与 Session 的顺序仍持久保存。已有自动目录在插件侧显示存储标题 default-workspace；官方 composer 对该历史标题仍会显示本地化默认名称，可通过工作区菜单自行重命名，插件不会改动用户目录或标题。 ## 数据与恢复 `WorkspaceRegistry.pinnedSessionIds` 始终是置顶成员资格的唯一权威。插件只在 `pinned_session_groups` storage domain 保存分组标题、组顺序和置顶 Session 的布局顺序。 移除插件会恢复官方 Workspace；原生置顶集合和 Session 数据不会被删除，分组 sidecar 数据会保留以供以后重新安装： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web remove @umialpha/dsh-session-groups dsh web ``` 如果插件入口激活失败，也使用上面的移除命令并重启 Web profile。Client HMR 不是跨入口事务，失败时不会自动恢复官方 Workspace。 ## 开发与验证 要求 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` 和 pnpm `11.28.5`。 ```sh pnpm install pnpm run typecheck pnpm run lint pnpm run build pnpm exec vitest run packages/client/ui-session-groups/tests node tests/install/session-groups.smoke.mjs --dsh-cli /absolute/path/to/dsh node tests/install/session-groups.smoke.mjs --public --dsh-cli /absolute/path/to/dsh ``` `--public` 使用公共 npm 中的四包，不构建、不打包、不添加本地 overrides；测试隔离 npm/pnpm 认证配置，仅操作临时 `DSH_HOME`。官方 CLI 版本也必须为 `0.2.1-alpha.2`。 当前完整实现任务与验证记录见 [T-002](tickets/T-002-complete-session-groups.html)。历史设计与评审材料可从 Git 历史查阅。 ## 作者与反馈 作者：[`umialpha`](https://github.com/umialpha) · [roy236977634@gmail.com](mailto:roy236977634@gmail.com)。问题和建议请提交到 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/umialpha/dsh-session-groups/issues)。 社区预览已发布到官方 [Show Your Plugins!](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/9426)，原文见 [community-post.md](docs/community-post.md)。[1024 社区目录初次投稿 PR](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins/pull/591)已合并；npm 发布后的[说明更新 PR #593](https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins/pull/593)已通过静态审核，等待维护者合并。目录网站的安装入口同步尚未核实。 ## 许可证 本项目的原创部分按 [MIT License](LICENSE) 发布。`@umialpha/dsh-client-ui-workspace-groups` 基于 DeepSeek Harness `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2` 的 Workspace 实现；上游代码继续保留 DeepSeek 的 MIT 许可与版权。完整归属见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)。

plugins.description: Windows correctness layer for DeepSeek Harness: encoding detection/conversion (GBK/GB18030/Big5/Shift-JIS), Windows path legality, netstat interpretation, and bounded read-only disk inspection.
One command installs four deterministic DeepSeek Harness plugins: 46 offline, bounded tools for JSON/YAML/CSV/encoding chores plus JVM, Python and Windows production diagnostics.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-toolbox-bundle

**一条命令，给 DSH 装上 46 个确定性工具**：JSON/YAML/CSV/文本/编码/正则这类"格式活"，加上 JVM、Python、Windows 生产报告的"诊断活"。纯本地、无网络、无安装期脚本、无二进制依赖。

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-toolbox-bundle)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-toolbox-bundle)
![tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-46-blue)
![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-214%20passing-brightgreen)
![offline](https://img.shields.io/badge/network-none-informational)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey)

## 30 秒安装

> **包名与仓库**：npm 上是 `dsh-toolbox-bundle`，仓库是 [`ax2/dsh-toolbox-bundle`](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-toolbox-bundle)。（前身 `dsh-zidev-toolbox`、`@ax2zicode/dsh-dev-toolbox` 都已在 npm 上废弃并指向这里——`dsh-dev-toolbox` 这个名字发不出去：npm 判定它与生态里已有的 `dsh-devtoolbox` 过于相似。）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-toolbox-bundle
```

装完**重启应用**（bundle 列表是启动时读的）。想装到桌面版就把 `web` 换成 `desktop`。

**家族总览**：[zicode.com/software](https://zicode.com/software/) 是四个插件、合装包与桌面软件的统一入口。

离线或固定版本：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ax2/dsh-toolbox-bundle/releases/latest/download/dsh-toolbox-bundle.tgz
```

> 这个包是**四个独立插件的合装层**：它一次插入四行 bundle，四个插件仍各自独立版本。**不要**把它和单独安装的那四个混用（会重复注册同名工具）。

## 15 秒看到效果

把这段贴进对话：

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "svc.py", line 42, in handle
KeyError: 'user_id'
```

模型会调用 `python_traceback`，拿回这样的结构化结果（实测输出）：

```json
{
  "exception_type": "KeyError",
  "exception_message": "'user_id'",
  "deepest_frame": { "file": "svc.py", "line": 42, "function": "handle" },
  "cause_hints": [{ "hint": "The mapping has no key 'user_id'; production data is usually missing the key that test data always has." }],
  "coverage": { "total_lines": 3, "parsed_lines": 3, "unknown_count": 0, "confidence": 1, "parser_version": "tb-1" }
}
```

其他几个一看就懂的：

| 你说 | 它调用 | 你拿到 |
|---|---|---|
| "校验 `{"a":1,}`，要精确行列" | `json_validate` | `line 1 / column 9 / position 8` + 错误文案 |
| "`C:\temp\CON.txt` 这个路径能用吗" | `path_inspect` | `reserved_name`（error）：保留 DOS 设备名，带扩展名也算，`position: 8` |
| "贴上 jstack，有没有死锁" | `java_thread_dump` | Java 级死锁环（`waiting_for`/`holding` 链）、锁竞争队列、状态直方图 |
| "这是 GC 日志，p99 停顿多少" | `java_gc_log` | 事件与停顿计数、p50/p90/p99、Young/Full 拆分、promotion failure |
| "`netstat -ano` 里谁在监听 8080" | `netstat_parse` | 监听项 + PID/进程名，并按状态分组；**文本里没有的绝不编造** |
| "D 盘哪个目录最占空间" | `dir_usage` | 总字节、最大文件、扩展名直方图（只读，符号链接从不跟随） |

## 装了哪四个

| 插件 | 工具 | 做什么 | 测试 |
|---|---|---|---|
| [dsh-deterministic-tools](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-deterministic-tools) | 29 | JSON 校验（精确行列偏移）/ 受限 JSONPath / 结构化 diff / CSV↔JSON / YAML↔JSON / 文本统计 / 正则捕获 / base64·hex·URL 编解码 / 哈希 / Unicode·进制·颜色·CIDR·JWT·时间戳检查 | 35 |
| [dsh-jvm-doctor](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-jvm-doctor) | 5 | thread dump（含 Java 级死锁环）/ GC 日志 / Maven·Gradle 依赖冲突 / 异常链（`... N more` 还原）/ Spring 配置 diff（载荷前脱敏） | 47 |
| [dsh-py-doctor](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-py-doctor) | 6 | traceback 根因 / pytest 摘要 / Django migrations·N+1·checks / celery 报告 —— 每个都带解析覆盖率 | 75 |
| [dsh-win-native](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-win-native) | 6 | 编码检测与转换（GBK/Big5/Shift-JIS 置信度）/ Windows 路径合法性 / netstat 解读 / 只读磁盘巡检与重复文件 | 57 |

## 为什么不直接让模型自己算？

**它确实能算。** 我们实测过：不给插件、只让它算 `hello world` 的 sha256，模型自己写了两轮 pwsh，**算对了**。所以这些工具卖的不是"模型做不到"，而是：

- **一次就对的概率**——214 个测试盯着的固定实现，而不是每次现写命令、和引号/编码/PowerShell 版本搏斗；
- **可复现**：同样输入永远同样输出；
- **边界明确**：结构化输入超预算**拒绝**（`INPUT_TOO_LARGE`），文本截断按 code point 并标 `truncated`，解析覆盖率与未识别行**明确上报**；
- **知道自己不知道**：`jwt_inspect` 声明不验签、`netstat_parse` 不编造进程名与 UDP 状态、诊断工具只出事实不做因果推断；
- **结构化回执**：`{ result, meta }` 可以直接进下一步，而不是让模型解析自由文本。

## 它要花多少 token（实测，不是估算）

工具 schema 每个请求都要发，**装了不用也要付**：

| 配置 | 工具名数 | 首次请求 inputTokens |
|---|---|---|
| 干净 headless base | 75 | 11,931 |
| base + 这四个插件（46 工具） | 121 | **19,608**（+7,677，占 39%） |

同一个"校验 JSON 并给精确行列"的任务：不装插件，模型自己写 pwsh 走 3 步、输出 1,323 tokens、13.0 s；装插件 2 步、输出 314 tokens、6.1 s，但 **raw token 反而多 17%**。

**所以：一次性小活它更贵。** 划算的是聚合压缩（内容不进上下文）、结果远小于输入、shell 一行搞不定的活、以及模型算不准的活。只想留常用的就按 id 覆盖：

```yaml
# profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: deterministic-tools
  config:
    only: [json_format, json_validate, json_query, text_diff, csv_to_json]
    toolPrefix: zi
```

（同一任务实测三组首次请求 prompt：干净 base 75 个工具名 **12,838** → 只留 5 个 **13,529**（+0.7k）→ 装全部 29 个 **16,799**（+4.0k）。裁剪配置要写进 **profile 自己的** `cordis.patch.yml`（文件头写着 "applied after every bundle layer"）；用 `dsh --patch <file>` 那种 CLI 覆盖层改同一个 id 会报 `patch: entry "deterministic-tools" not found`。真实启动后模型只收到 `zi__json_format`、`zi__json_validate`。）

## 边界

- **46 个工具里只有 2 个碰磁盘**：`dir_usage`、`file_duplicates`，都是只读、有文件数/字节预算、软链接与 junction 跳过并上报、从不跟随。
- 其余全部是**纯文本/纯字节分析**：你不给数据，它不会自己去读。
- 不发网络请求、不装二进制、不写安装期脚本（pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦不住它）。
- 超预算**拒绝**而不是静默截断；截断一定标出来。

## 从哪来

这四个插件是 [zi-devtools](https://github.com/ax2)（Rust 工具箱，16 个 crate / 154 个工具）在 DSH 上的对应实现：按同一份契约（回执信封、预算门禁、边界行为）用 TypeScript 重写，独立版本、独立测试。

- npm：[dsh-deterministic-tools](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-deterministic-tools) · [dsh-jvm-doctor](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-jvm-doctor) · [dsh-py-doctor](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-py-doctor) · [dsh-win-native](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-win-native)
- 每个仓库都有 Release + 预构建 tarball（`releases/latest/download/<repo>.tgz`）

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Deterministic, offline, bounded tools for DeepSeek Harness: 29 JSON/YAML/CSV, text, encoding and inspection tools, each returning a byte receipt.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-deterministic-tools

**确定性、离线、有界的本地工具箱** — 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，向模型注册 29 个可复现的格式/数据/文本/编码/检查工具。

[![CI](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-deterministic-tools/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-deterministic-tools/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
MIT License · DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 验证通过 · Node ≥ 20.10

> 纯本地 · 零网络 · 零凭据 · 无时钟无随机 · 每次调用都带字节回执

---

## 快速开始

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-deterministic-tools)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-deterministic-tools)
![tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-29-blue) ![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-35%20passing-brightgreen) ![network](https://img.shields.io/badge/network-none-informational) ![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-lightgrey)

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deterministic-tools
```

装完**重启应用**（bundle 列表是启动时读的）。想一次装齐四个插件（含 [jvm-doctor](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-jvm-doctor) / [py-doctor](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-py-doctor) / [win-native](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-win-native)）用 [`dsh-toolbox-bundle`](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-toolbox-bundle)；**别和单独安装混用**（会重复注册同名工具）。

**家族总览**：[zicode.com/software](https://zicode.com/software/) 是四个插件、合装包与桌面软件的统一入口。

**15 秒看效果** —— 说"校验 `{"a":1,}`，要精确行列"，模型调用 `json_validate`，拿回（实测输出）：

```json
{ "valid": false,
  "error": { "message": "expected a double-quoted property name but found '}'", "line": 1, "column": 9, "position": 8 },
  "top_level_type": "unknown" }
```

**为什么不让模型自己写 pwsh？** 实测里它确实写得出（`ConvertFrom-Json` 也能报错），但：
- **一次就对**：固定实现 + 35 个测试，而不是每次和引号、编码、PowerShell 版本搏斗；
- **边界明确**：结构化输入超预算**拒绝**（`INPUT_TOO_LARGE`），文本截断按 code point 并标 `truncated`；
- **可组合**：`{ result, meta }` 回执直接进下一步，不用模型解析自由文本。

相邻插件：[dsh-jvm-doctor](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-jvm-doctor)（JVM 生产报告）· [dsh-py-doctor](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-py-doctor)（Python/Django）· [dsh-win-native](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-win-native)（Windows 编码/路径/netstat）· [dsh-toolbox-bundle](https://github.com/ax2/dsh-toolbox-bundle)（一条命令装齐，共 46 个工具）

---

## 为什么需要它

Agent 在需要「把这段 JSON 格式化」「这段文本里有什么不可见字符」「这个 CIDR 覆盖哪些地址」「这个 base64 解出来是不是 UTF-8」时，目前只能：

1. 调用 `pwsh` / `bash` 硬凑 —— Windows 上引号、GBK/UTF-16 编码、控制台代码页全是坑，一次失败要烧掉好几轮 token；
2. 或者在回答里**心算** —— 不可复现，也无法验证。

而生态里的供给几乎为空：收录的 4,508 个 DSH 插件条目里，正则类全网只有 2 个包、编码类 1 个包，**没有任何「确定性工具箱」形态的插件**；官方 profile 自带的 200+ 个 `@deepseek-ai/*` 包里也只有文件、终端、搜索这类能力，没有格式与数据处理。

本项目把这些操作变成**模型可见的工具**：结构化入参、结构化出参、有界、可复现。

## 设计契约：每个结果都是回执

每个工具的规范返回值固定为：

```json
{
  "result": "…工具自己的载荷…",
  "meta": {
    "bytesIn": 15,
    "bytesOut": 45,
    "truncated": false,
    "notes": []
  }
}
```

模型看到的内容就是 `result`（字符串直接给，对象/数组给格式化 JSON），**只有**当发生截断或需要解释时才会追加一行页脚：

```
[bounded] input=262144B output=262144B
[note] object keys sorted recursively
```

干净的调用不花额外 token；有问题的调用一定说清楚。

### 边界行为（三种，绝不混淆）

| 情况 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| 结构化输入超预算 | **抛错拒绝**：报出实际字节、上限，并明确「没有任何截断或部分处理」 |
| 文本输出超预算 | **截断 + `truncated: true` + note**，截断发生在 code point 边界 |
| 结构化/编码结果超预算 | **整体返回 + 标记**：规范值无法部分裁剪，就明确说出来而不是悄悄弄坏它 |
| 不支持的语法/选项 | **显式拒绝**并列出允许值（不猜、不降级、不静默忽略） |
| 无法保证最小/精确 | 返回诚实标记（如 `text_diff` 的 `coarse: true`、解析器的 `unknown_lines`/`confidence`） |

## 安装

npm（推荐）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-deterministic-tools
```

预构建 tarball（与 npm 上是同一份产物，无需构建步骤，也避开 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 授权）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ax2/dsh-deterministic-tools/releases/latest/download/dsh-deterministic-tools.tgz
```

要固定版本就把 `latest/download/dsh-deterministic-tools.tgz` 换成 `download/v<version>/dsh-deterministic-tools-<version>.tgz`。

本地开发：不安装，直接挂载构建产物。

```sh
pnpm install && pnpm build
dsh --profile web --patch ./cordis.local-overlay.yml --dump-config   # 先验证层合成
dsh --profile web --patch ./cordis.local-overlay.yml                 # 再启动
```

`cordis.local-overlay.yml`（仓库内已提供，等价的 patch 也可手写）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: deterministic-tools-local
      name: 'D:/dsh/dsh-deterministic-tools/lib/index.js'
```

## 配置

`apply(ctx, config)` 接受以下配置（全部可选，含默认值）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `maxInputBytes` | `262144` | 结构化输入的硬上限（UTF-8 字节），超过即拒绝 |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `262144` | 结果渲染的软上限，超过即截断或标记 |
| `maxMatches` | `1000` | 查询/正则返回的匹配数上限 |
| `maxDiffEntries` | `2000` | diff 报告的差异条数上限 |
| `maxPatternChars` | `1000` | 正则表达式长度上限 |
| `regexInputBytes` | `65536` | 正则堆栈上限（JS 回溯无法抢占，所以单独收紧） |
| `maxRecords` | `20000` | CSV 解析/生成的记录数上限 |
| `toolPrefix` | `''` | 工具名前缀，例如 `zidev` → `zidev__json_format` |
| `only` | `[]` | 只注册指定工具（空 = 全部） |

## 工具清单（29 个）

### JSON（5）

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `json_format` | 严格解析 + 固定缩进 + 可选递归键排序 |
| `json_minify` | 压成单行 |
| `json_validate` | 校验并给出**精确的** line / column / position（自带扫描器，不依赖引擎错误文案）；语法错误是成功结果，不是异常 |
| `json_query` | 受限 JSONPath：`$`、`.a`、`['a']`、`[0]`、`[*]`、`..a`，返回规范化路径 |
| `json_diff` | 结构化差异（JSON Pointer + add/remove/replace），标量数组可按多重集比较 |

### 文本（6）

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `text_stats` | 字节 / UTF-16 / code point / 行 / 词 / CJK / 非 ASCII / EOL 风格 |
| `lines_process` | dedupe、trim、drop_empty、compact、sort、sort_desc、reverse、number；保留输入的结尾换行、报告输入 EOL 风格（输出统一 LF） |
| `case_convert` | camel / pascal / snake / upper_snake / kebab / dot / title / lower / upper |
| `text_diff` | 行级统一格式 hunk（带行号）；超出 LCS 单元格预算时降级并标 `coarse: true` |
| `regex_find` | 编号/命名捕获组、字符偏移、1-based 行号，匹配数有界 |
| `regex_replace` | `$1` / `$<name>` / `$$` / `$&` 替换，替换次数有界 |

### 数据（4）

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `yaml_to_json` | YAML → JSON；报出精确行列；限制 anchor/alias 展开（防 billion laughs） |
| `json_to_yaml` | JSON → YAML，固定缩进、可选键排序 |
| `csv_to_json` | RFC 4180（引号、字段内换行）、分隔符自动探测、ragged 行统计 |
| `json_to_csv` | 对象/数组数组 → CSV，列顺序取键的首次出现顺序或显式指定 |

### 编码（8）

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `base64_encode` / `base64_decode` | 标准与 URL-safe 字母表；解码前先校验字母表和 padding；非法 UTF-8 **明确上报** |
| `hex_encode` / `hex_decode` | 可选大小写与分隔符；容忍 `:`/`-`/`,`/空白 |
| `url_encode` / `url_decode` | component / form / path / full 四种模式；畸形 `%` 序列计数上报；孤立代理项（unpaired surrogate）显式拒绝并给出下标 |
| `url_inspect` | 拆解 scheme/host/port/path/query/fragment + 解码参数 + 风险提示（内嵌凭据、明文 HTTP、IDN） |
| `hash_text` | sha256 / sha512 / sha1 / md5，hex 或 base64，支持 base64 二进制输入 |

### 检查（6）

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `unicode_inspect` | 逐 code point：`U+XXXX`、UTF-8 字节、类别、文字系统、显示宽度、标志（控制/不可见/bidi/同形字混淆）；支持 NFC/NFD/NFKC/NFKD 对比 |
| `number_base` | 2–36 进制精确互转（BigInt），支持 `0x/0b/0o` 前缀，越界数字拒绝 |
| `color_convert` | `#rgb`/`#rrggbb`/`#rrggbbaa`/`rgb()`/`hsl()` → hex/RGB/HSL/HSV + 相对亮度 + WCAG 对比度 |
| `cidr_inspect` | IPv4/IPv6 网段：网络地址、掩码、广播、首末地址、地址总数、可用主机数、私有/回环/链路本地/CGNAT/组播/ULA 分类 |
| `jwt_inspect` | 解出 header/payload/alg/kid/签名字节数/exp/iat/nbf，判断是否过期 —— **明确声明不验签** |
| `timestamp_convert` | epoch（s/ms/µs/ns 或按量级自动）与 ISO 8601 互转，含偏移渲染、星期、闰年、分解 |

## 开发

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck              # tsc --noEmit，0 错误
node --test test/           # 35 个用例，覆盖全部 29 个工具的组装路径
pnpm build                  # 产出 lib/（ESM + .d.ts，导入已改写为 .js）
pnpm smoke                  # 用 lib/ 产物 + stub registry 验证 29 个工具全部注册
```

测试分三类：

1. **组装路径**：`definition.execute(args, exec)` → `definition.output.render()`，断言 `result` / `meta` / 页脚；
2. **契约**：每个工具的 schema、描述长度、注册表参数校验（非法 enum 由 registry 在 `execute` 之前拒绝）；
3. **性质测试**（`test/properties.test.ts`，固定种子可复现）：自写 JSON 扫描器与 `JSON.parse` 的差分对照（400 组含随机变异的语料）、格式化的幂等性与值保持、base64/hex/百分号编码/CSV/进制/时间戳的往返、行操作幂等性。

> 这组性质测试在 v0.1 期间抓到过一个真实缺陷：`lines_process` 会丢掉输入结尾的换行（`"a\nb\n"` → `"a\nb"`）。现在它的结果里带 `trailing_newline` 与 `eol_in`，输出忠实复现结尾换行，跨平台换行会说清「输出统一为 LF」。

## 兼容性与风险

- 官方插件 API 自称 **pre-stable，无冻结承诺**；本插件只依赖最稳定的两个面：`ctx.tools.register(defineTool(...))` 与 `apply(ctx, config)`。
- **验证到什么程度（不夸大）**：`tsc --noEmit` 0 错误；35 个用例在真实 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 上跑通组装路径（含 registry 的参数校验）；`lib/` 产物被 `scripts/smoke-built.mjs` 加载并注册全部 29 个工具；`dsh --profile web --patch ./cordis.local-overlay.yml --dump-config` 在 `dsh 0.2.0-rc.2` 上合成成功；npm 上的版本用 `dsh plugin --profile <scratch> add` 装进一个临时 profile 后，真实 `dsh` 启动把包括本包 29 个在内的全部工具 schema 发给了模型（会话日志里逐个核对过）。**真实对话也跑通了**：同一个临时 profile 接上本机 desktop profile 用的那条 LLM 路由（`tencent-token-plan`）后，模型在一个真实回合里主动调用了 `json_format`（`indent: 2`、`sort_keys: true`），拿回递归排序后的 JSON 与 `[note]` 页脚并原样复述（会话 `session-0a4eb911`）。**尚未做**：跨多个真实会话的调用统计（这属于 M3）。
- 正则工具无法中断 JS 回溯 ⇒ 用 `regexInputBytes`（默认 64 KiB）与 `maxPatternChars` 把风险框住，并在描述里写明。
- `text_diff` 的精确匹配有单元格预算，超出会给出 `coarse: true`，不假装最小差异。

## Roadma

plugins.description: One restart button for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI that works with your setup: systemd, Docker, Kubernetes, pm2, launchd, terminal, Windows. Restarts in place, zero dependencies.
plugins.readme_text:
A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) web GUI plugin that adds one small **Restart dsh** button above Settings. It is for the moments you need a restart: you installed a plugin, changed a config, or fixed a bug in your own plugin. **Agents can do it too.** A `dsh_restart` tool lets an agent restart dsh after installing or editing a plugin. With a `continue_prompt`, it is woken in the same session once dsh is back and carries on. **It works with *your* setup.** systemd, Docker, Kubernetes, pm2, a tmux pane, a plain terminal or Windows: click, and dsh is back in a few seconds. The page reloads by itself. ```bash npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-restart-anywhere ```

## Works with your setup Most restart buttons kill dsh and hope something starts it again. That only works for the setup their author had. A detached "relaunch me" helper gets killed along with a systemd service. A clean exit doesn't trigger `Restart=on-failure`. A container without a restart policy just stops. And under pm2 or runit, the helper and the supervisor both start dsh and fight over the port. dsh-restart-anywhere doesn't hand dsh's life to anyone else. It restarts dsh **in place**: | Your setup | What happens | Leaves behind | | --- | --- | --- | | **systemd** (user or system unit, any `Restart=` policy) | Asks systemd to restart the unit, so you get a fresh process, exactly like `systemctl restart`. If that's not permitted (a system unit, no root), it falls back to in-place. | nothing | | **Docker / Podman / Kubernetes** (with or without a restart policy) | In place: same PID, so the container never notices. | nothing | | **pm2, supervisord, launchd, runit, s6, nssm, forever, …** | In place: the supervisor keeps seeing the process it started, still running. | nothing | | **Terminal, tmux, screen, nohup** | In place: same PID, and the new dsh keeps printing to the same terminal. Ctrl-C still stops it. | nothing | | **Windows / Node < 22.15** | Wrapper: the old process stays as a thin parent of the new dsh. It forwards Ctrl-C and exits with dsh's exit code. | the parent process | | **dsh desktop app** | Button hidden: the app manages its own lifecycle. | n/a | No supervisor detection, no config, no root, no helper scripts. ## How it works 1. **Graceful shutdown.** The plugin calls dsh's own exit hook (`ctx.appExit`). Every plugin tears down exactly as on a normal quit, and sessions are flushed. 2. **The process becomes the new dsh.** - **Linux / macOS, Node ≥ 22.15:** [`process.execve()`](https://nodejs.org/api/process.html#processexecvefile-args-env) swaps the process image for a fresh dsh with the same command line, environment and stdio. The PID doesn't change, and nothing is left behind. - **Windows / older Node:** the process stays alive as a small wrapper and starts the fresh dsh as its child. Later restarts reuse the same wrapper, so there's never more than one. - **systemd:** systemd restarts the unit itself, via a one-second transient timer, so the HTTP reply reaches your browser first. 3. **The page reloads.** The browser polls until a server with a new boot ID answers, then reloads. That works however fast or slow the restart is. Details that make it hold up: - **`--port 0`:** a random port is pinned on restart, so the page finds dsh again. - **No browser-tab spam:** `--no-open` is added on relaunch. - **Double clicks:** a second request while a restart is running gets `409`. ## Install Into your dsh **web profile** (`web` below is the profile name; use whichever profile backs your web GUI). From a source checkout, use `pnpm dsh` instead of `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh`: ```bash npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-restart-anywhere ``` This installs the package into the profile and adds it to `dsh.profile.bundles`. Reload the browser tab, and **Restart dsh** shows up above **Settings**. If it doesn't, restart dsh one last time the old way. From then on, the button does it. Requires dsh 0.2.0 or newer and Node 20+. There's no build step and no runtime npm dependencies. ## Using it Click **Restart dsh** and confirm. The icon spins while dsh restarts, and the page reloads when the new dsh is up, usually within about 5 seconds. > Running agent sessions are interrupted by a restart, like with any restart. The confirmation dialog says so. ## For agents: the `dsh_restart` tool Agents get the same restart as a tool, e.g. after installing or editing a plugin they want to test. - **`dsh_restart({ continue_prompt? })`:** restarts dsh exactly like the button. - **`continue_prompt`:** once dsh is back, the agent is woken in the same session with this text as its next instruction. Leave it out and the session just stays stopped. - **Root sessions only:** subagents don't get the tool. - A wake older than 5 minutes is dropped, so a restart that never happened can't wake a session later. ## Security - **Login required:** the restart route is registered through dsh's own `/api` connection layer (`ctx.connection.fetch`). It only answers browsers that are logged in to your dsh, and dsh's Host/Origin fence applies. - **Exposed instances are safe:** on an instance reachable from the internet, an unauthenticated request gets `401` and can't restart anything. - **No shell commands:** nothing is run through a shell. The only external program is `systemd-run`, and only when dsh is a systemd service. ## Tested Verified live with dsh 0.2.0 on Linux: - **systemd:** user unit, with `Restart=no` and `Restart=on-failure`. - **systemd fallback:** in place, when `systemd-run` is unavailable. - **Plain terminal:** in place via `execve`, three restarts in a row, then Ctrl-C and SIGTERM. - **Wrapper path:** Node without `execve`, three restarts in a row, then Ctrl-C. - **Supervisor that only restarts on failure:** dsh stays up and the supervisor never notices. - **`--port 0`**, and two clicks at once. - **`dsh_restart` tool:** an agent calls it with a `continue_prompt`, under systemd and in place via `execve`. Both times it was woken in the same session within seconds and finished the task. The session still reloads cleanly afterwards. macOS uses the same `execve` path as Linux, and Windows the same wrapper path as old Node. Neither has been run on real hardware yet, so reports are very welcome. `npm test` runs the setup detection and command-line checks, plus the agent tool and wake-up logic against a fake dsh. ## License MIT > **中文简介** · DeepSeek Harness (dsh) Web 界面插件：侧边栏「设置」上方的一个小小的「重启 dsh」按钮，适用于**你的**部署方式 —— systemd、Docker / Podman、Kubernetes、pm2、supervisord、launchd、终端 / tmux / nohup、Windows。原地重启（进程 PID 不变），无需检测或配置守护进程，重启完成后页面自动刷新。Agent 也能用：`dsh_restart` 工具重启 dsh，并可在 dsh 恢复后用 `continue_prompt` 唤醒同一会话继续工作。零运行时依赖，无需配置。
安装：`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-restart-anywhere`

plugins.description: DSH 临时 profile 实验台：一键建隔离 profile（模板建 / 从现有 profile 克隆）、装插件、跑 headless 探针会话、读回会话摘要并安全回收——改插件不再怕把本体改暴毙。零第三方依赖。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-profile-lab

> 给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）用的**临时 profile 实验台**：一条命令建出隔离的 profile，装插件、跑 headless 探针会话、起驻留 web 实例验 HTTP/渲染面、读回结构化摘要、安全回收。
>
> 它存在的唯一理由：**改插件时怕把本体改暴毙**——先在隔离环境里验，确认无误再装进日常用的 profile。

- 宿主半侧插件（Cordis），注册 6 个 `tmpprofile_*` 模型工具；**没有浏览器半侧**，不声明 `dsh.client`。
- `inject` 只写 `['tools']`（**不写 `webServer`**）——所以在 headless / tui 这类没有 HTTP 服务的 profile 里不会整体 pending。
- **零第三方运行时依赖**：只用 `node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:child_process` / `node:zlib` / `node:crypto`。

---

## 它解决什么

| 老做法（每次现写脚本） | 本插件 |
|---|---|
| 想隔离测试，但官方 `--from-default-profile` 只能从 5 个内置模板初始化、**不能从现有 profile 克隆**，还要求目标目录不存在 → 手工 `New-Item` + 写 4 个文件 | `tmpprofile_create`：模板建 **或** `clone: "desktop"` 克隆（配置复制 + `node_modules` 逐项链接复用） |
| 以为 `--from-default-profile` 必然启动，没法"只建不跑" | 内部走 `--dump-config` 短路 boot（**只建、不启动**） |
| 跑探针要手拼 `DSH_HOME` + 环境变量 + `dsh --profile X "任务"`，跑完还要自己去 `sessions/` 里翻会话 | `tmpprofile_run`：一次调用完成"装配 → 跑 → 返回 sessionId 与事件摘要" |
| **验不了渲染端 / HTTP 面**（headless 根本没有 HTTP 服务），只能手搓 pwsh 起 `dsh web --port` 再 curl | `tmpprofile_web_start` / `web_probe` / `web_stop`：起**驻留 web 实例**、探任意路由、按 pid 收（跨插件重载也能收） |
| 读回验证要自己解**多帧 zstd**（`session.v4.jsonl.zstd`），几乎每个会话都重写一遍 Python | `tmpprofile_session`：内置逐帧解码，直接给 preset / 工具面 / 上下文 / token |
| 清理靠自觉（历史上真的漏过两次，残留至今） | `tmpprofile_clean`：清单白名单 + junction 感知删除 + 残留自检 |
| junction 直接 `Remove-Item -Recurse` 有删进源仓库的风险 | 先 `lstat` 判链接、解链接，再递归删目录；**绝不跟随链接** |

---

## 安装

```powershell
# 从本地目录装（开发态）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:/repository/dsh-profile-lab

# 或从 GitHub 装
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:<你的账号>/dsh-profile-lab
```

装完**重启 DSH**（插件在启动时装配）。桌面版的 profile 由 Electron 独占管理，命令行直连会被拒——用桌面版插件页装，或走应用内通道。

---

## 十个工具

| 工具 | 干什么 | 关键参数 |
|---|---|---|
| `tmpprofile_create` | 建隔离 profile（模板 / 克隆）＋可选装包 | `name`、`template`（默认 `headless`）、`clone`、`packages`、`purpose`、`overwrite` |
| `tmpprofile_install` | 往已登记的临时 profile 追加安装 / 移除 | `name`、`packages`、`remove` |
| `tmpprofile_run` | 跑一次 headless 探针会话（同步、带超时） | `name`、`task`、`sessionId`、`env`、`timeoutMs`、`json` |
| `tmpprofile_web_start` | 起**驻留 web 实例**（真实 HTTP 服务，验 host 路由/渲染面） | `name`、`port`、`probePath`、`waitMs`、`cwd`、`env` |
| `tmpprofile_web_probe` | 对驻留实例发一次 HTTP 探针 | `name`、`path`、`method`、`timeoutMs` |
| `tmpprofile_web_stop` | 停掉驻留实例（`taskkill /T /F` + 确认端口释放） | `name`、`waitMs` |
| `tmpprofile_session` | 读会话日志给结构化摘要 | `sessionId` 或 `name`、`sections`、`limit` |
| `tmpprofile_list` | 列出「本插件管的」与「未登记的」profile | — |
| `tmpprofile_clean` | 清理（默认 dry-run，需 `confirm: true`；会先停实例） | `names`、`confirm`、`sessions`、`archiveTo` |
| `tmpprofile_fingerprint` | 采集 `profiles/` 指纹，自查有没有碰到别的 profile | `exclude` |

> 工具名以 `tmpprofile_` 开头，便于在 `dsh-tool-manager` 里整组启用/禁用。

**典型闭环（模型视角）**：

```
# A. host 面：装配 + 工具面 + 会话行为
tmpprofile_create  { name: "probeA", template: "headless", purpose: "验证 dsh-xxx 的工具面", packages: ["link:C:/plugins/dsh-xxx"] }
tmpprofile_run     { name: "probeA", task: "只回复两个字：OK" }
tmpprofile_session { name: "probeA", sections: ["preset","tools","contexts"] }

# B. 渲染 / HTTP 面：起真实例，探插件的 host 路由
tmpprofile_create    { name: "webA", template: "web", packages: ["link:C:/plugins/dsh-xxx"] }
tmpprofile_web_start { name: "webA", probePath: "/api/dsh-xxx/status" }
tmpprofile_web_stop  { name: "webA" }

tmpprofile_clean   { names: ["probeA", "webA"], confirm: true }
```

> **web 实例与 headless 探针验的不是同一件事**：headless 给 **host 侧装配事实**
> （哪个 entry 没激活、卡在等哪个服务），web 实例给 **HTTP/渲染面事实**
> （端口真的在听、插件的 host 路由真的注册了、页面能加载）。两者都要，才有完整画像。
> 注意 `web_start` 要求 profile 的 bundles 里有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`——
> 用 `template: "web"` 建，或从带 web-app 的 profile 克隆。

更多配方见 [docs/RECIPES.md](docs/RECIPES.md)。

---

## 安全护栏（都是刻意的）

1. **只动自己建的**：只有登记在 `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab.json` 里的临时 profile 才可被写/删；`desktop` / `backup` / `web` / `headless` / `dsh-tui` / `rescue` / `reserve` / `acp` / `sdk` / `sdk-minimal` 一律硬拒。
2. **删链接不删目标**：`node_modules` 里的 junction/symlink 先 `lstat` 判定再解链接，然后才递归删目录。
3. **克隆不共享写面**：克隆时 `node_modules` 里的每一项单独链接（不是整目录一个链接），所以随后 `pnpm add` 只改写新 profile，源 profile 一个字节都不动。
4. **clean 默认演练**：不传 `confirm: true` 只返回"将要删除什么"。
5. **覆盖要显式**：`overwrite: true` 只允许覆盖已登记的同名 profile，旧的挪到 `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab-trash/`，不直接删。
6. **失败留痕**：profile 先登记再装包，装包失败也留在清单里，能被 `tmpprofile_clean` 回收。
7. **进程内 + 跨进程锁**：同一 profile 不允许并发运行；跨进程写操作走 `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab.lock`（陈旧锁 120s 自动抢占）。
8. **审计日志**：每次 create / install / run / clean 追加一行到 `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab-log.jsonl`。
9. **驻留实例是刻意的例外，且加倍设防**：`tmpprofile_web_start` 起的 web 实例会**驻留**（这是它存在的意义），所以：同一 profile 只允许一个实例；端口从 19399 起自动挑空闲的；stdout/stderr 只留尾部环形缓冲；进程**不 detach**（留在宿主 Job Object 内，宿主退出连带杀掉）；插件卸载时 `killAllWebInstances()` 再扫一遍；`tmpprofile_clean` 删目录前先按清单 pid 停实例。
10. **不做后台任务**：DSH 的子进程在宿主的 Job Object 里（宿主退出会连带杀死），所以 `tmpprofile_run` 一律**同步 + 超时**（默认 300s，上限 900s，超时 `taskkill /T /F` 杀整棵进程树）；唯一的常驻形态就是上面那三条 `web_*` 工具，并且必须由调用方显式停止（或用 `clean` 兜底）。

---

## 配置（cordis 行 config，全部可选）

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-profile-lab
      name: 'dsh-profile-lab'
      config:
        home: 'C:/Users/you/.dsh'      # 缺省 $DSH_HOME 或 ~/.dsh
        dshBin: ''                      # 显式指定 dsh 的 lib/bin.js（缺省自动探测）
        nodePath: ''                    # 显式指定跑子进程的 node（缺省 process.execPath）
        tools:
          disabled: ['tmpprofile_fingerprint']   # 按名字关掉工具
```

### dsh 可执行文件是怎么找的

按优先级探测，每条都用 `-V` **实测**（`app.asar` 是文件，`existsSync` 看不到内部路径，只能试跑）：

1. `config.dshBin` / 环境变量 `DSH_LAB_DSH_BIN`
2. **宿主安装锚点**：宿主进程的 `profileContext.installAnchor` → `<安装>/…/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js`，用 `process.execPath` + `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`（版本与宿主一致，兼容性最好）
3. npm 全局安装：`%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh\lib\bin.js`
4. `C:\dsh-runtime\<版本>\...`

实测样例（Windows + 桌面版宿主）：宿主锚点 → `0.2.0-rc.2`（host 同版本）；兜底 npm 全局 → `0.2.1-alpha.1`。

---

## 会话日志是怎么读的

`session.v4.jsonl.zstd` 是**多帧** zstd（DSH 每追加一批事件压一帧）。Node 的 `zstdDecompressSync` 对多帧输入**只解第一帧且不报错**，也不暴露"剩余未消费字节"——整段丢进去只拿到 254 字节的 header。

官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 的做法是：按 zstd 魔数（`0xFD2FB528`，小端 `28 B5 2F FD`）扫描帧起点，再逐帧解压。本插件用同一思路并利用"one-shot 只解第一帧"的特性把实现压到最短：对每个魔数偏移试解一次，成功即得该帧，伪魔数（解出来不是 `{` 开头）直接跳过。

实测：6.51 MiB 压缩 → **4322 帧** → 20 MiB 文本 → 6901 事件，摘要正确。

---

## 两个 DSH 侧的坑（本插件都已堵掉）

1. **工具返回值必须是 lossless JSON**。只要返回值里出现 `undefined`（哪怕只是某个可选字段），DSH 会把整条结果拒收，模型看到的是
   `tool "x" returned invalid output: value is not lossless JSON` 而不是数据。本插件在所有工具出口统一做了一次净化（丢 `undefined`、非有限数转 `null`）。
2. **headless 的 `--json` 是投影，不是日志**。它用自己的一套事件名（`tool_call`、`tool_result`、`status`、`thinking`…），**不含**日志里的 `tool/call`；
   官方文档也明说它"caps every string except the terminal `final` at 8 KiB and omits events the projection does not model"。
   所以「到底调了哪些工具」必须以磁盘上的完整会话日志为准——`tmpprofile_run` 已经替你把这一步做了：返回值里的 `session.tools` 就是完整日志的工具面。

---

## 自检

装好之后（或改动代码之后）可以直接跑内置自检——它会真建一个临时 profile、装本插件、跑一次 headless 让模型调用 `tmpprofile_list`、再清理：

```powershell
node scripts/selfcheck.mjs
```

退出码 0 表示插件在真实 DSH 里能加载、工具可被调用、清理无残留。

---

## 测试

```powershell
# 单元测试（全部在临时 DSH_HOME 里跑，不碰真实环境）
npm test

# 真实闭环（会真建 profile、真跑一次 headless、真清理；消耗极少量 token）
$env:DSH_LAB_LIVE='1'; node --test tests/live.test.js
```

live 测试的硬断言：**除本次建的临时 profile 外，`profiles/` 里其他 profile 的指纹（hash + mtime）必须一个字节不变**。

---

## 限制（明确不做）

- **不是危机救援工具**：主力 profile 起不来时，本插件也起不来。要救援请用 `rescue` / `reserve` 实例。
- **web 实例只验到"服务端+静态资源"这一层**：端口在听、路由在答、页面 HTML 能取到；页面里 JS 真的执行、UI 真的渲染出来，只有真浏览器加载才会发生（需要的话自己打开 `http://127.0.0.1:<port>/` 看）。
- **不做脱离宿主的任务**：见上文 Job Object。
- **不自动纳管已有的临时 profile**：`profiles/` 里历史残留（例如早年手工建的目录）会出现在 `unmanaged` 列表里，需要你确认后用 `adoptProfile` 显式纳管，本插件不会自动动它们。
- **共享 `DSH_HOME`**：探针会话仍写在主力的 `sessions/` / `storages/` 下（同一 home 无跨进程锁）。要彻底隔离得用独立 `DSH_HOME`，尚未实现。

---

## 文件位置

| 内容 | 路径 |
|---|---|
| 清单 | `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab.json` |
| 审计日志 | `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab-log.jsonl` |
| 跨进程锁 | `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab.lock` |
| 覆盖时丢弃的旧 profile | `$DSH_HOME/profile-lab-trash/` |
| 临时 profile | `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/` |

## 许可

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-copy-session-id Copy a Session's ID in **DeepSeek Harness**, from either of two places: a Session row's `⋯` menu in the sidebar, or the copy button in the header of the Session you have open. One click puts the full id (`session-e7797998-430a-4d2c-aba6-6d7f441f4f70`) on your clipboard, with the host's own top-centre toast confirming it.

> 侧边栏会话菜单、以及当前会话标题栏，都能一键复制会话 ID
中文说明（点开） 两个入口，同一个动作： - **侧边栏会话行的 `⋯` 菜单**最后多出一行 **复制会话 ID**（用宿主自己的 `MenuItemButton` 与 `Toast`，样式、悬停态、↑/↓/Tab/Esc 键盘行走和焦点归位都和内置行一致）； - **会话标题栏右侧**（那排工具的 `⋯` 左边）多出一个复制图标，复制的是**当前打开的这个会话**。 第二个入口是为**子代理会话**准备的：它们的 ID 只能这样拿——`sidebar.workspaces` 会把带 `origin: 'subagent'` 的行整个隐藏，所以子代理会话在侧边栏里根本没有座位。标题栏的 `⋯` 下拉本身没有插槽（它的选项由 `session-log-export` 写死），因此插件只能作为它旁边的同级控件出现。 这是个**纯界面插件**：Host 半边是空的 `apply`，不写文件、不发请求——ID 本来就在浏览器侧，会话标题栏和会话行都拿得到 `sessionId`。 复制的是**会话 ID**，不是标题。浏览器拒绝剪贴板写入时会显示「复制失败，请手动复制会话 ID」，而不是绿色成功提示。 安装：DSH「添加插件」里填 `github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-copy-session-id#v0.2.1`（本地目录要用**绝对路径**），装完**重启桌面端**。卸载就是反过来，在插件列表里移除再重启。
## Install DSH → **Add plugin**: ```text github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-copy-session-id#v0.2.1 ``` ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:kjx-talesofai/dsh-plugin-copy-session-id#v0.2.1 ``` Then **restart the desktop app**: the plugin row is what makes the harness serve the browser half into the page. A local checkout works too, with an absolute path. Upgrading is uninstall-then-install. Requires **DSH Desktop ≥ 0.2.0-rc.1** (the `peerDependencies` range on `@deepseek-ai/dsh` that the harness enforces). Verified by hand on macOS (Apple Silicon) · DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2; re-checked on 0.2.1-rc.2, where the menu row still registers and takes its seat at order 500. ## How it works | | | |---|---| | Slots | `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item`, order `500`, with `separatorBefore` — after the shipped `archive` (400); and `conversation.session.header.utilities`, order `-5` — between `open-in-app` (`-10`) and the header's own `⋯` menu (`0`) | | Feedback | `shell.overlay`, rendered with the host's `Toast` — one shared toast for both surfaces (the menu row unmounts with the menu) | | Host atoms | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` — `MenuItemButton`, `Button`, `Toast`, `writeClipboard`, the icons | | Build | none — `client.js` is the shipped artifact, written in the loader's `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` format | ## Development ```sh npm test # node:test — no install needed, and nothing to build ``` `tests/plugin.test.mjs` runs `client.js` through `node:vm` against a recording context: both surfaces, both rendering paths, every clipboard settle path (success, `false`, rejection, no Clipboard API), the locale seat and the effect disposers. It does **not** cover the rendered menu or the real clipboard write — those were confirmed by hand on the configuration above. `tools/asar.mjs` is a dev-only ASAR reader for inspecting the installed dsh packages, and is not part of the published tarball. ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 Jiaxin Kou

Built by [Jiaxin Kou](https://hypersampling.com) · [GitHub](https://github.com/kjx-talesofai)

# dsh-pr-gate

> **If this helps you, please give it a star** — it helps others find it. Thanks!

Deterministic write gate for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) —
**the CI gate moved to the moment of the write.**

Every file the agent writes (`write` / `edit` / `str_replace_editor`) passes
the same scope policy and residue rules that
[agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate) applies to PRs
in CI — deny-before-write in `tools/pre-execute`, residue scan of the written
text in `tools/post-execute`, and a durable content-hashed JSONL ledger of
every decision. Zero LLM calls in the trust path: the parts of the gate that
must NOT be an LLM live here.

## Why now (checked 2026-10-12)

The review/guard lane in the dsh ecosystem is entirely LLM-shaped:
answer-reviewer plugins re-read turns with a second model, `dsh-gungnir`
verifies goal completion from exit codes, and the closest action-guard
(`cc-safety-net`, 1.6k★ in the Claude ecosystem) blocks destructive commands.
**Nobody gates what the agent writes deterministically** — scope policy,
residue markers, or a durable record the CI can consume. That slot is empty,
and this plugin is the [agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate)
engine living inside the runtime instead of waiting for the PR.

## What it does

| Stage | Hook | Deterministic action |
|---|---|---|
| Before the write | `tools/pre-execute` | Scope policy: deny globs always win; a non-empty allow list means "only these". Denied writes never touch the disk |
| After the write | `tools/post-execute` | Residue scan of the written text: injection text aimed at reviewers, skipped tests, debug markers. `warn` (default) logs + ledgers; `block` also fails the write with corrective feedback |
| Always | JSONL ledger | One line per decision — tool, path, action, `sha256` of content, matched pattern, residue kinds. `agent-pr-gate` CI can consume it as the session-side record |

## One policy, two enforcement points

Point `policyFile` at your repo's `agent-pr-gate.yaml` and the live session
enforces the same allow/deny the CI gate enforces on PRs — all policy entries
are unioned. Inline `allow`/`deny` config works without a file.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-pr-gate
```

From npm — no build step, no `allowBuilds` authorization; git installs are equally prebuilt (`lib/` ships in the repo).



## Configure

```yaml
- id: dsh-pr-gate
  name: dsh-pr-gate
  config:
    tools: [write, edit, str_replace_editor]
    allow: [src/**, docs/**]     # non-empty = only these
    deny: ["**/*.pem", .github/workflows/**]
    policyFile: ""               # or e.g. agent-pr-gate.yaml
    residueMode: warn            # warn | block
    ledgerPath: .dsh-pr-gate/session.jsonl
```

## Compatibility

- **DSH**: verified against the 0.2.x line (source snapshot 0.2.1-alpha.2); installs on any profile via `dsh plugin add` (prebuilt `lib/`, no build approval).
- **Node**: >= 20 (CI matrix: Node 20/22/24 on Ubuntu and Windows).
- **Disposable-profile evidence (2026-10-19)**: `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> add github:zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate` → installed in 30s; boot shows `[dsh-pr-gate] active: …`; `dsh plugin --profile <fresh> remove dsh-pr-gate` → dependencies cleared, bundles restored.

## Develop

```sh
npm install
npm test   # syncs the vendored agent-pr-gate core, builds, runs unit tests
```

The scope glob semantics and residue rules are vendored from the sibling
`agent-pr-gate` checkout (`npm run sync`; CI runs `sync --check`).

## Roadmap

- `bash` command write-heuristics (redirect/shell-write detection, warn-only)
- Ledger → GitHub check-run bridge (session attestations surfaced in CI)
- Per-policy selection by agent preset, matching the CI gate's policy classes
- Claims-vs-diff at turn end (the agent's final summary vs. the session ledger)

## Kill criteria

If dsh ships first-party deterministic write gating, or reviewer plugins
converge on deterministic enforcement (they are all LLM-based today), this
freezes at its last working version with a postmortem here. The engine stays
owned by agent-pr-gate either way.

# dsh-plugin-backup

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A backup plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it packages `$DSH_HOME` into verifiable,
restorable, downloadable archives by category, and can mirror those backups to
GitHub. Everything is available from three faces that share one engine and one
single-run lock: the **Web settings page**, the **model tool surface**, and a
**CLI session**.

- Naming: `dsh-backup-<YYYYMMDD>-<HHmmss>`
- Categories: `settings`, `skills`, `plugins`, `sessions`, `storages`
- Per backup: **download / verify / restore / delete**
- Settings: **backup path**, **backup interval**, per-category switches, retention count,
  verify-after-create, per-category archive ceiling, GitHub sync
- No build step and no third-party runtime dependency: the host half is plain ESM,
  the browser half is a hand-writable CommonJS factory the shell loads as-is

## Install

```powershell
# local checkout (development)
dsh plugin --profile web add file:C:/path/to/dsh-plugin-backup

# or from GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shiinakaze/dsh-plugin-backup
```

The Desktop app manages its own `desktop` profile: install through its plugin
manager (or `dsh plugin --profile desktop add …`) and restart the app.

`dsh plugin add` both records the dependency and appends the package name to
`dsh.profile.bundles` (one composition layer). Reload or restart the Web
interface afterwards, then open **Settings → Data backup**.

> **Runtime support.** The plugin targets the `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.7 and 0.2.0
> lines: `peerDependencies` declare `^0.1.7-rc.2 || ^0.2.0-rc.1` for `dsh-tools`
> and `dsh-typert-protocol`, and `engines.dsh` mirrors that window. This matters
> on 0.2.0, whose boot performs a compatibility preflight against the running
> runtime and **refuses to install or mount a bundle whose dsh peers it cannot
> satisfy** — an exact pin to one rc would be rejected. The two branches are not
> cosmetic: package managers resolve with npm's prerelease rule, under which a
> prerelease is admitted only when some comparator pins its exact version tuple,
> so one `>=0.1.7-rc.2 <0.3.0` window silently drops `0.2.0-rc.1` and
> `0.2.0-rc.2` and fails `npm install` with `ERESOLVE`. Keep the window in
> `package.json` in step with the APIs the plugin actually uses.

> A `file:` install is a **snapshot**: the profile keeps its own copy, so after
> changing this package's source you must `dsh plugin --profile web remove <name>`
> and add it again. The measured verification log lives in
> [docs/verify.md](docs/verify.md).

> This is a DSH plugin, not a plain dependency: the host half injects the `tools`
> service declared in its schema, and the browser half is discovered through the
> `dsh.client` declaration in `package.json`. Without `$DSH_HOME` the plugin falls
> back to `~/.dsh`; in a non-Web profile (no `webServer` service) only *download*
> is unavailable — every other feature and tool still works.

## The page

Settings → **Data backup**:

| Block | Contents |
|---|---|
| Backup settings | Backup path (empty = `C:\Users\<user>\dsh_backups` on Windows, `~/dsh_backups` elsewhere; `~` and `${DSH_HOME}` are expanded), interval (off / 15 min / hourly / 6 h / daily / weekly), backups to keep, verify right after creating |
| Backup categories | The **selection** for a run: check the categories to include, with select-all / select-none; the button names the current choice ("Back up now (3 categories)") and is disabled with a hint while nothing is selected |
| Existing backups | Per row: id, creation time, file count, size, category tags, last verdict; actions are a **download** menu (one category or the manifest), **verify**, **preview restore**, **restore**, and **delete** (restore and delete take a second click to confirm; delete is the destructive-colored one) |
| GitHub sync | Enable switch, `owner/repo`, branch, subdirectory, token environment variable, whether a token was detected, and **push / pull** |

"Back up now" covers only the checked categories; saving the settings also makes that
selection the default for scheduled runs.

Settings are written to the plugin's own user layer at
`$DSH_HOME/dsh-plugin-backup/settings.json` (`0600`); the deployment baseline stays
in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and the two are shallow-merged (user wins).

## Layout on disk

```
<backupPath>/
  dsh-backup-20260930-141205/
    manifest.json           # schema version, host facts, per-category files/bytes/sha256/archive, last verdict
    settings.tar.gz         # one gzipped USTAR archive per category
    skills.tar.gz
    plugins.tar.gz
```

The manifest is written last and atomically, so "a directory with a manifest" is a
complete backup. Intermediate files carry a `.part` suffix while a run is in
flight; residue from a crash is cleaned up or ignored at the start of the next run.

## Categories and exclusions

| key | Sources (relative to `$DSH_HOME`) | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `settings` | `settings.yaml*`, `cordis.patch.yml*`, `.credentials.yaml*`, `.anonymous-user-id`, `dsh-skill-hub.json`, `skills-market-sync.json` | on |
| `skills` | `skills-management/**` | on |
| `plugins` | `profiles/*/package.json`, `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm-workspace.yaml`, `cordis.patch.yml*`, plus `plugins/**` | on |
| `sessions` | `sessions/**` | off |
| `storages` | `storages/**` | off |

Always excluded: `node_modules` and `.git*` at any depth, symbolic links, and the
backup root itself — so keeping the store inside `$DSH_HOME` never recurses.

### Measured on a real harness home (`settings` + `plugins` + `skills`)

| Category | Files | Raw | Archive | Duration |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `settings` | 5 | 2.0 KB | 1.3 KB | < 0.1 s |
| `plugins` | 39 | 1.24 MB | 1.12 MB | 0.2 s |
| `skills` | 29 356 | 342.5 MB | 144.8 MB | ≈ 50 s |

Creation and verification are streaming (flat memory; measured RSS went 57 MB →
158 MB), so a category is never held in memory. That is why the default ceiling is
**512 MiB**: a realistic skills tree already passes 100 MiB compressed. Raise
`maxArchiveBytes` in the settings if yours is larger, or leave `skills` out and
back it up by hand. With retention 20 and `skills` enabled the store can reach ~3 GB.

## GitHub sync

1. Enable sync on the settings page and fill in `owner/repo` (a full URL also works),
   the branch, and the subdirectory.
2. Token resolution, in order:
   - an environment variable — `DSH_BACKUP_GITHUB_TOKEN` by default (renameable in settings);
   - the state file `$DSH_HOME/dsh-plugin-backup/github-token.json` holding `{"token": "…"}`, mode `0600`.
   The token is read from nowhere else and never written to config, logs, or tool output.
3. **Push** uploads file by file through the Contents API, archives first and
   `manifest.json` last; a backup the remote already holds with the same content is
   skipped. **Pull** downloads only the backups missing locally and verifies every
   archive against the sha256 in its manifest — a mismatch discards that backup and
   reports why.

Remote layout: `<subdir>/<backupId>/{manifest.json,<category>.tar.gz}`.

## Model tools

| Tool | Parameters | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `backup_run` | `categories?`, `label?` | Create a backup now |
| `backup_list` | `limit?` | List backups, newest first |
| `backup_verify` | `id` | Recompute sha256 and re-read the tar structure, per category |
| `backup_restore` | `id`, `categories?`, `dryRun?`, `force?` | Restore; `dryRun` only reports the plan |
| `backup_delete` | `id`, `force?` | Delete; the newest backup is protected while an older one exists |
| `backup_sync` | `direction`, `ids?` | Push to or pull from GitHub |

A typical loop: `backup_run` before a risky change, then `backup_verify` and
`backup_restore` afterwards. `backup_restore` verifies first and refuses a corrupt
backup unless `force` is set.

## Safety boundaries

| Situation | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| Path traversal | Backup ids must match `^dsh-backup-\d{8}-\d{6}$`; archive entries refuse absolute paths, drive letters, and `..` |
| Corruption | `verify` names the category and the expected/actual sha256; `restore` refuses by default and, under `force`, skips that category and reports it |
| Irrevers

# dsh_plugin_refresh

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2-4d7cfe.svg)](#compatibility)

**Install a DSH plugin and use it immediately — no restart.**

`dsh_plugin_refresh` is a DeepSeek Harness host plugin that watches the installed
composition and finishes plugin activation in the running process: it verifies the
bundles a plugin-manager operation could have left unmounted, re-drives them through
the same typed path the Web Plugins page uses, and reloads plugin code whose files
changed at an unchanged path. It never writes your profile manifest or patch layers.

> 中文说明见下方「中文文档」一节。本插件解决的是：**插件安装完成后无需重启 DSH 即可生效**。

---

## Why it exists

DeepSeek Harness already applies a *fresh* bundle install in-process when the profile is
live (the `hmr` service is composed): the plugin manager selects the bundle and calls
`reconcileProfilePatches`, and `app-boot/config-reload` follows. Three real cases still
end in "takes effect at the next start", and all three are covered here:

| Case | What happens without this plugin |
|---|---|
| The install named a dependency the profile already had (reinstall / upgrade / local re-link) | `installBundle` returns `application: "restart-required"` **before** reloading — the selection is saved, nothing mounts. |
| The first import of the plugin failed | Node caches the failed module job. Every later retry of the same module URL rejects with the same error, so the plugin stays dead until the process restarts — even after you fix the file. |
| The plugin's own files changed at the same path (rebuilt bundle, re-linked local dev plugin) | Installed packages live under `node_modules`, which the official hot-reload service ignores by design; the running process keeps the old code generation. |

## Prior art, and what is actually different here

Several DSH plugins already attack "no restart". Saying so plainly is part of shipping this one:

| Project | Approach | Overlap |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-hot-reload](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-hot-reload) | swaps an upgraded plugin in place, rolls back when the reload fails, otherwise asks for a manual restart | highest — the same in-place swap idea as `lib/deep-reload.js` |
| [dsh-hot-installer](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-hot-installer) | hot install / remove / update / enable-disable of profile bundles; states that module-code changes still need a restart | high, on the host composition side |
| [dsh-hotreload-plugin-manager](https://github.com/kyorakuyk/dsh-hotreload-plugin-manager) | the same, plus a Web settings tab | high; adds a browser UI |
| [dsh-refresh](https://github.com/Woeful001/dsh-refresh) | a sidebar button that refreshes the inventory and reloads the page | complementary — it owns the browser half |
| [dsh-plugin-refresh](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-refresh) | right-click → full page reload | same idea from the browser side; note the similar name |

What this package does that the others do not:

1. **It repairs a failed first import.** A plugin whose first import fails stays dead for the life of
   the process, because Node keeps the failed module job cached — fixing the file and retrying
   changes nothing. This pass drops the poisoned job and re-imports, which is why a broken install
   can still become usable without a restart.
2. **It surfaces the real error.** The plugin manager reports `failed to import` and nothing more;
   `repairs[].probe.error` carries the underlying exception, which is usually the whole answer.
3. **It is automatic and dependency-free.** Only `node:` builtins — no chokidar, no js-yaml, no build
   step (the file you edit is the file that runs). Detection is event-driven, with a fingerprint poll
   as a backstop, rather than a button someone has to press.
4. **It supports local `link:` installs**, whose real path sits outside the profile and whose bare
   specifier this runtime cannot resolve; the row is activated through its resolved URL instead.

Where it is weaker, plainly: no browser UI, no install/uninstall/update actions (it deliberately
performs no package operations), a small unit-test suite rather than an integration one, and it
reaches into Node loader internals, so it is sensitive to the DSH and Node version.

## What it does

One serialized pass, run on startup, after every `plugin-manager` operation, and when a
watched file changes:

1. **Deep reload** — every live plugin whose module files changed at an unchanged path is
   re-imported and re-activated in place, using the same steps as the official
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hmr` service: drop the Node ESM `loadCache` (with
   `Map.prototype.delete`, required on Node 24) and the CommonJS `require.cache` for the
   plugin's own package, re-import, `registry.delete()` the old generation, re-activate on
   the same fibers, and re-attach the original Loader `Entry` so entry identity, config and
   diagnostics survive the swap.
2. **Repair** — for a bundle that is selected but has no running row, it drops the poisoned
   module job, imports the declared module once to capture the *real* failure reason, then
   re-drives the composition through `pluginManager.setBundleEnabled()` — the official path,
   which takes the profile writer lock and the hot-reload queue itself. If the runtime still
   cannot resolve the row's declared specifier, the row is activated through its already
   resolved file URL (see *Local installs* below).
3. **Report** — a per-bundle health table (selected, running rows, error) and a bounded pass
   history, available in the log and over HTTP.

## Install

From this repository — no npm publish required:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lixiaohao001/dsh_plugin_refresh
```

From a local clone, which is also the development setup (the package is linked, so edits are live):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/dsh_plugin_refresh
```

Or from an agent session, the `plugin_manager` tool action `install_bundle` with the same absolute
path. The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so it installs as a profile bundle and inserts
exactly one row:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: plugin-refresh
      name: dsh_plugin_refresh
```

## Configuration

Row config is validated by the exported schema when `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` is reachable,
and normalized by `lib/config.js` either way.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `autoCheck` | `true` | Check after startup and after every plugin-manager operation. |
| `autoRepair` | `true` | Re-drive a bundle that was just installed or enabled but has no running row. |
| `deepReload` | `true` | Reload plugin modules whose files changed at an unchanged path. |
| `watchProfile` | `true` | Watch the profile patch files and manifest. |
| `devWatch` | `[]` | Extra absolute files or directories to watch for plugin development. |
| `devReload` | `true` | Deep-reload when a `devWatch` path changes. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `2000` | Interval of the fingerprint poll that backs up file watching; `0` disables it. A pass compares recorded size and modification time only, so it is cheap. |
| `debounceMs` | `400` | Quiet window that combines a burst of change events into one pass. |
| `startupDelayMs` | `1200` | Delay after application readiness before the first check. |
| `route` | `/api/plugin-refresh` | Status route prefix; an empty string disables the HTTP surface. |
| `verbose` | `false` | Log passes that found nothing to do. |

```yaml
- id: plugin-refresh
  config:
    devWatch:
      - /absolute/path/to/my-plugin/lib
```

## HTTP surface

Loopback-only, same as the Web server it registers on.

| Method | Path | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/plugin-refresh/status` | Config, engine generation, snapshot size, last pass, bundle health, pass history. |
| GET | `/api/plugin-refresh/status?detail=1` | Adds the per-entry module snapshot (file paths, recorded size and mtime). |
| POST | `/api/plugin-refresh/check` | Run one pass now. |
| POST | `/api/plugin-refresh/repair?bundle=<name>` | Verify and repair one bundle (all unhealthy bundles when `bundle` is omitted). |
| POST | `
