**可按模型分别计价**的账。

```
会话日志（每条 assistant/message 自带 provider/model + usage）
   └─ lib/usage.js   按 attempt 归属到它自己的路由，按 attempt 当时的时刻判断高峰/非高峰（仅峰谷价模型）
        └─ lib/rates.js   查单价表 → 整数最小单位（1e-6）累加
             ├─ 工具 session_cost / list_session_costs   （模型可调，精确到每次调用）
             ├─ 命令 /cost                                （不花 token，直接看）
             └─ 界面 💰 药丸                              （会话级近似，可一键与日志核对）
```

## 数字从哪来（以及哪一半是精确的）

| 数字 | 来源 | 精确度 |
|---|---|---|
| token 桶 | 已落盘的 `assistant/message.data.usage`（缺省回退到流里最后一个 `usage` chunk） | **精确**，与 DSH 自己的 `tokenUsage` 投影逐字节一致（[见验证](#验证)） |
| 路由归属 | 该条 assistant 消息自己的 `message.source.provider/model` | **精确**，中途换模型会分成多行分别计价 |
| 高峰/非高峰 | 该次调用的 `event.time` | **精确到规则**：周一至周五 01:00–04:00、06:00–10:00（按 `offPeakTimezone`，默认 UTC）为高峰，中国法定节假日全天按非高峰；**只对峰谷价模型生效**（键名含 `deepseek` 或 `peakPricing: true`），其余模型全天一个价 |
| 单价 | 本插件的 `rates` 配置 | **取决于你填的对不对**；未配置的模型只统计 token、不计金额，并明确列出来 |
| 💰 药丸 | `tokenUsage` + `modelSelection` 两个投影 | **近似**：整段对话按当前模型计价；换过模型时请点「与日志核对」或看 `/cost` |

缓存写入（`cacheWriteTokens`）DeepSeek 不单独计费，因此默认按普通输入（cache miss）价计价，
可用 `cacheWrite` 覆盖。金额用**整数最小单位**（1e-6，即"微元"）累加，避免长对话里浮点误差；
单位是 `currency` 那一个，不是美元。

## 安装

```powershell
# 在 dsh-session-cost 目录下
node install/install.mjs                 # 装进默认 desktop profile（含默认单价表）
node install/install.mjs --dry-run       # 先看会改什么
node install/install.mjs --currency '{"symbol":"$","code":"USD","perUsd":1}'   # 若账号按美元计费
node install/install.mjs --uninstall     # 卸载
```

安装做三件事，每件都有 `.dsh-session-cost-<时间戳>.bak` 备份：

1. 把包**实体复制**到 `<profile>\node_modules\@local\dsh-session-cost`（不用符号链接：源目录
   曾被链接清空过一次；实体复制还能让 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的裸导入走 profile 自己的解析路径）
2. profile `package.json`：加 `file:` 依赖，并把包名追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`
   （这一步才让它出现在「插件」页的**已安装**里）
3. profile `cordis.patch.yml`：用受管块按 id 覆写两行，写入单价表 / 货币 / 非高峰设置

**装完**：改 `lib/index.js`、`lib/command.js` 等宿主半边 → **完全退出 DSH 再启动**；
改 `lib/client.js`（界面半边）→ 页面**硬刷新**（Ctrl+R）。插件页 → 已安装 →
`@local/dsh-session-cost` → 任一行 → **配置**，可直接编辑单价表（表单由本包自己渲染，
因为 DSH 只提供 `plugins.row.config` 扩展点、不自带渲染器）。

> 实测差异（本插件开发时踩到的）：**首次**把包加进 profile 会让运行中的 DSH 热重组，
> 宿主侧的工具/命令/路由**立刻可用**；但**插件模块本身不会被重新导入**——之后再改
> `lib/*.js` 并刷新副本，运行中的进程仍在跑旧代码，必须重启 DSH 才会换新。界面半边的
> 插槽注册发生在页面加载时，所以至少要硬刷新一次。

> 另一个实测差异：**DSH 自己开着的沙箱可能只允许写工作区**。这种情况下
> `<profile>\cordis.patch.yml` 能写、`<profile>\node_modules\@local\dsh-session-cost\` 却
> `EPERM`——因为前者在允许列表里、后者不在。安装器会逐文件复制并把
> `NOT updated (permission denied): lib/ ...` 明确打出来（而不是假装成功），此时**行已改、
> 模块还是旧的**：换一个能写该目录的权限重跑同一命令即可，不需要退出 DSH。
> 注意这与「文件真的被运行中的 DSH 锁住」（`EBUSY`）是两回事，安装器分开报告。

## 配置字段

**在界面里填单价**（推荐）：插件页 → 已安装 → `@local/dsh-session-cost` → 任一行 → **配置**。
那一页的「模型单价」是一张**可编辑表格**，每个模型一行，直接输入数字即可：

```
模型（<provider>/<model>）   未命中   命中缓存   缓存写入   输出
deepseek-official/deepseek-flash   2     0.04              8    ×
deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro  9     0.3              27    ×
[＋ 添加模型]   留空的「命中缓存 / 缓存写入」= 与未命中同价

模型   未命中   命中缓存   缓存写入   输出
DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash   ¥2   ¥0.04   ¥2   ¥8      ← 只读预览（跟随 currency）
DeepSeek-V4-Pro       ¥9   ¥0.3    ¥9   ¥27

▸ 高级：直接编辑 rates JSON
```

- **未命中、输出必填**；命中缓存 / 缓存写入留空 = 与未命中同价（DeepSeek 的缓存写入不单独计费）；
- **「＋ 添加模型」**加一行，每行的 **×** 删掉该行（至少留一行）；
- 表格只改这四列，**同一模型上的其它字段会被保留**（`label`、`offPeakMultiplier`、
  `inputOffPeak` 等），不会因为你在界面上改了一个价就把高级设置悄悄删掉；
- 模型名必须写成 `<provider>/<model>`，**可以直接复制下面只读预览里的键名**；
- 下面是**只读预览**：按当前 `currency` 标注单位，把每个模型的四个单价列全，一眼能看出
  「我填的价会不会被这么算」；
- 最下面的**「高级」**是可折叠的 `rates` JSON 原文——要写表格没有暴露的字段
  （`inputOffPeak` 之类）时用它；两处是同一个值的两个视角，改哪边都会同步另一边的表格；
- **保存前会校验**：缺 `input`/`output`、值不是数字、模型名没有 `/`、模型名重复，都会**拒绝保存**
  并指出是**哪一行哪个字段**——因为 Host 挂载时会拒绝这种表，那会让整个读数不显示，
  所以宁可在这里拦住。

字段清单（表格没覆盖的部分用「高级」直接写）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `rates` | DeepSeek 官方价（见下） | JSON：`"<provider>/<model>"` → 每 100 万 token 的单价，**单位与 `currency` 一致** |
| `currency` | `{"symbol":"¥","code":"CNY","perUsd":1}` | 展示货币；`perUsd` 是 1 美元兑多少该货币 |
| `offPeakMultiplier` | `0.5` | 非高峰价 = 高峰价 × 该系数，**只对「峰谷价」的模型生效**（见 `peakPricing`） |
| `offPeakTimezone` | `UTC` | 判断高峰时段的 IANA 时区 |
| `offPeakHolidays` | 空 = 用内置清单 | 中国法定节假日（`YYYY-MM-DD`，逗号分隔），这些日期全天按非高峰价 |
| `dshHome` | 空 | 空 = `$DSH_HOME`，再退回 `~/.dsh` |

单价表每个条目可用的字段：

| 字段 | 必填 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `input` | ✅ | 未命中缓存的输入价 |
| `output` | ✅ | 输出价 |
| `cacheRead` | | 命中缓存的输入价；缺省 = `input` |
| `cacheWrite` | | 缓存写入价；缺省 = `input`（DeepSeek 不单独计费） |
| `label` | | 界面/报告里显示的名字，如 `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` |
| `peakPricing` | | 该模型是否有高峰/非高峰两档价；**不填时按键名判断：含 `deepseek` 才是 `true`，其余一律 `false`（固定价）** |
| `offPeakMultiplier` | | 该模型自己的非高峰系数，覆盖全局值；只对 `peakPricing: true` 的模型生效 |
| `inputOffPeak` / `cacheReadOffPeak` / `cacheWriteOffPeak` / `outputOffPeak` | | 直接写死非高峰价，覆盖系数；同样只对峰谷价模型生效 |

**峰谷价只属于 DeepSeek**。这是实测踩到的第二个坑：插件原来把非高峰折扣套在了**每一条**已配置
单价的路由上，于是本机真实存在的 `our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free`（只有一个固定价）被算成
半价，面板还理直气壮地写着「非高峰 ×0.5」——那个模型根本没有低谷时段。现在的规则是：

- 键名含 `deepseek` 的路由 → 峰谷价（`deepseek-official/*`、`deepseek-account/*`）；
- 其它一切路由 → 固定价，全天按表里的价格，面板显示「固定价」；
- 想覆盖就在该条目写 `peakPricing: true`（比如 DeepSeek 模型走了别的 provider 名，
  或某个转售商也分时计价）或 `peakPricing: false`（比如 DeepSeek 模型被按平价转售）。

实测（本机全部会话日志 + 已装配置）：修复前 `our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free`
合计 **¥0.945**，修复后 **¥1.8907**，正好差一倍；同一份数据里三条 DeepSeek 路由金额
一分不变（¥48.9713 / ¥10.5830 / ¥0.523）——也就是这次修正没有动到本来就正确的部分。

默认表按 [DeepSeek 官方定价](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/) 的**高峰价**
填写，单位是**人民币元 / 百万 token**——因为 DeepSeek 账号本身以人民币计费、余额也按人民币变动。
非高峰由 `offPeakMultiplier: 0.5` 折半（官方非高峰价为高峰价的一半）：

```json
{
  "deepseek-official/deepseek-flash": { "label": "DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash", "input": 2, "cacheRead": 0.04, "output": 8 },
  "deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro": { "label": "DeepSeek-V4-Pro", "input": 9, "cacheRead": 0.3, "output": 27 }
}
```

> **为什么默认是人民币，而不是美元**：这是实测踩到的坑。DeepSeek 的官方文档同时给出美元价
> （Flash 高峰 `$0.3 / $0.006 / $1.2`）。早期版本照抄美元价、`currency` 写 `$`，于是同一个
> 会话显示 `$1.1262`，而平台余额实际扣了 **¥9.06**——看起来像"统计少了一个数量级"，其实是
> **币种错了**，而且因为不能拿中美汇率当 1 用，误差正好是汇率倍数。把单价表和 `currency` 都
> 换成账号自己的人民币口径后，同一个会话算出 **¥4.9610**，与平台对得上。
>
> 如果你的账号是美元计费（或你想看美元），把 `rates` 换成美元价、`currency` 换成
> `{"symbol":"$","code":"USD","perUsd":1}` 即可——**两处必须同时改**，只改一个就会差一个汇率。

**高峰时段**（官方脚注）：周一至周五 `01:00–04:00` 与 `06:00–10:00` **UTC**，
**不含中国法定节假日**——节假日全天按非高峰。窗口是规则，节假日是日历，所以后者是
`offPeakHolidays` 数据：内置 2026 年清单，**每年 11 月国务院公布次年安排后需要更新**
（不更新只会把工作日节假日按高峰算，即偏高，不会偏低）。留空就用内置清单，填了就完全替换。

这个窗口**只对峰谷价的模型生效**（键名含 `deepseek`，或显式 `peakPricing: true`）；
固定价模型不看时间，也就不会因为节假日/时段变化而算错。`offPeakHolidays` 与
`offPeakTimezone` 只在前者身上起作用。

价格会变，**请以官方页面为准**自行更新。

## 用法

### 1. 界面：消耗药丸 + 明细面板

对话输入框上方（DSH 自带统计药丸那一排）会多一个胶囊：

```
● ¥0.0138 · 129k / 1.00M ⌄        ← 圆点：灰=空闲，绿=正在跑；未配置价格时描边转警告色
● ¥10.3089 · 284k / 1.00M ⌄       ← 金额是本会话（或家族）的花费，token 数是「当前上下文」
● ¥8.2288 [含派生 4] · 144k / 1.05M ⌄   ← 派生出过子代理时：金额是「本会话 + 派生会话」
```

**token 数字刻意用 DSH 自己的口径**：`已用 / 窗口`，也就是「下一次调用要发送的长度」。
这是 DSH 自带统计显示的那个数，用它才不会让人以为两边对不上（见下面「三个 token 数」）。

**只要这个对话派生出过子代理 / workflow agent，胶囊的金额就是整个家族的花费**，并在后面
标出包含了几个派生会话——否则它会看起来比实际便宜（子代理是独立会话、独立计费，它们的
token 根本不在本会话的 `tokenUsage` 投影里，所以这个数必须问宿主）。鼠标悬停会写清全部口径：

```
deepseek-official/deepseek-flash · 本会话 ¥5.6821 + 4 个派生会话 ¥2.5467 · 家族合计 ¥8.2288
  · 整段对话累计计费 243,629,270 tokens（含缓存重读） · 本次新增 1,372,099 tokens · 当前上下文 144k / 1.05M
```

**路由一律写成 `<provider>/<model>`**（悬停提示、面板头部、`/cost`、工具返回都是），
因为 `rates` 就是按这个键写的：它指的就是你要去编辑的那一条，而且同一个模型名可能被两个
provider 提供，只写模型名分不出是哪一条。配置过的 `label` 只在有空间的地方补在后面，
如面板头部的 `deepseek-official/deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）`。

本会话自身的金额始终在同一行里，所以与 DSH 自带统计对照时不会失去参照。

点开是一个面板（点击外部或按 Esc 关闭；展开状态记在 `localStorage`，刷新后保持）：

```
对话消耗        deepseek-official/deepseek-flash（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash）  [非高峰 ×0.5]
对话消耗        our-free-model/mimo-v2.6-flash-free                  [固定价]   ← 这条路只有一个价，不分峰谷
██████████████░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░░   ← 金额构成条（本会话自身的构成）
■ 未命中 20%   ■ 命中缓存 2%   ■ 输出 78%      ← 图例：每种 token 的金额占比

输入 · 未命中缓存        1,000,000        ¥2.00
输入 · 命中缓存          1,000,000        ¥0.02
输入 · 缓存写入                  0

plugins.description: 项目书生成 - 科研项目申报书撰写技能包（DSH plugin）
plugins.readme_text:
# 项目书生成（proposal-generator-cn）
> **一键安装**：已在 [DSH Market](https://dsh.market/) 收录（搜索「proposal-generator-cn」或「项目书」），市场面板里点安装即可。也可手动：`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile desktop add ccccty/proposal-generator-cn`


DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把「项目申报书」写作技能装进你的 DSH。

## 它是什么

一个技能 bundle。安装后，你的 DSH 会话就能按**真实申报件的文体**写项目书：

- **§1 文体铁律**——正文零元信息（11 类禁止项）、指标五拍论证（数值→基线→为何不够→为何能超→因此定为该值）、研究内容占正文 60–70%
- **§1.6 公式规范**——LaTeX 数学标记（`$$...$$` 与 `$...$`）白名单，转出的 .docx 里是 Word 原生 OMML 公式
- **9 份素材库**——评分权重、骨架 A/B、写作要点、合规避坑、信源链接、真实申报件拆解（共 ~600 KB）
- **2 个工具**——`md2docx.py`（Markdown→Word，仿宋_GB2312/黑体/楷体排版 + 自动目录 + 公式）与 `latex_omml.py`（LaTeX→OMML 引擎）

## 安装

### 本地安装（已下载本目录）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "D:/work/deepseekherness/对话区2/proposal-generator-cn"
```

（把 desktop 换成你实际用的 profile；web 版就是 `--profile web`）

### 从 GitHub 安装（发布后）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:<你的用户名>/proposal-generator-cn
```

## 使用

新开会话后直接说：

> 用 proposal-generator-cn 技能，根据这份指南写一份项目申报书

或把指南文件丢给会话，技能会自动匹配触发。

## 工具用法

```powershell
python "C:/Users/<你>/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/proposal-generator-cn/skills/proposal-generator-cn/tools/md2docx.py" 输入.md 输出.docx
```

要求：Python 3.8+，`python-docx`、`lxml`。

## 技能名说明

技能名必须是 kebab-case（`^[a-z0-9-]+$`），所以目录名是 `proposal-generator-cn` 而不是中文「项目书生成」。中文显示名在 description 里。

## 发布到 dsh.so 市场

1. 把本目录推到 GitHub 仓库（名字建议就叫 `proposal-generator-cn`）
2. 在仓库加主题标签 `dsh-plugin`
3. 市场索引会自动抓取（awesome 列表机制），或向 dsh-market 的源列表提交你的仓库

## 版本

v1.0.0 · 基于 SKILL.md v1.2（含 §1.6 公式规范）

plugins.description: A hotkey binder plugin for dsh, allows user to bind specific keys to trigger dictation.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-dictation-hotkey

Press-to-talk dictation for the DSH Web composer. Hold a key combination, speak,
release — DSH's own speech engine transcribes it and the text lands in the
composer.

The plugin adds **no second recognizer**: it drives the speech Remote that DSH
already ships with its voice-input bundle (local SenseVoice, CPU) and inserts the
result through the official composer actions.

```
hold Ctrl+Shift+Space ──▶ speak ──▶ release
        │
        ├─ microphone capture in the page (getUserMedia + AudioWorklet, muted output)
        ├─ encoded as the canonical 16 kHz mono PCM16 WAV the Remote requires
        ├─ ctx.remote.speech.transcribe()      ← official speech Remote (SenseVoice)
        └─ inputActions.insertText() / submit() ← official composer
```

## What it does

- **Push to talk**: `hold` (record while held) or `toggle` (press to start, press
  to stop) trigger modes.
- **Fill or send**: insert the transcript for review, or submit it immediately.
- **Reuses DSH's engine**: the same local SenseVoice provider the official
  microphone button uses — no extra process, model download, or cloud API.
- **Composer-native insertion**: text is spliced into the live draft through
  `inputActions.insertText`, so the caret, references, and attachments survive.
- **Configurable per browser**: hotkey, mode, send behaviour, beeps, and
  diagnostics live in a popover on the composer pill (`localStorage`).
- **Works on the new-conversation screen too**: with no session open there is no
  composer draft to splice into, so the transcript is pasted into the focused
  composer as a normal edit, and the pill returns with the first session.
- **Diagnosable**: optional per-keystroke log with audio level, audio length, and
  inference time, which separates "nothing was picked up" from "the recognizer
  missed it".

## Requirements

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` or a compatible release, Web profile.
- The official **voice input** bundle enabled (plugin manager → 语音输入). It
  provides the speech engine; without it the pill reports that no recognizer is
  mounted.

## Install

```sh
# from a checkout
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-dictation-hotkey

# or straight from git (no clone, no build: the bundle is committed)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey
```

Then reload the Web UI. The bundle is committed at `client/dist/client.js`, so a
checkout works without a build step.

Updating later: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:AndyYang12345/dsh-dictation-hotkey`
again and restart `dsh web` — a profile keeps its own copy of the installed
package, so pushing to GitHub does not update an already-installed profile by
itself.

## Use

A **🎙 Dictation** pill appears under the composer:

| Action | Result |
|---|---|
| Hold `Ctrl+Shift+Space`, speak, release | Transcript inserted into the composer |
| Click the pill | Settings: hotkey (press the keys to capture), fill ↔ send, hold ↔ toggle, beeps, diagnostics |

Releasing **any** key of the combination ends the recording, so there is no need
to lift them together.

On the home screen (no session yet) the pill is absent — the composer dock only
exists inside a session — but the hotkey still works: the controller stays armed
through a root-scope seat and the transcript is pasted into the focused composer.
Auto-send is skipped there, so sending stays your own keystroke.

## Settings

Stored per browser under `localStorage` key `dsh-dictation-hotkey.settings`.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `hotkey` | `Ctrl+Shift+Space` | `+`-separated combination; `Space`, `F9`, `Alt+~`, letters and digits are understood |
| `mode` | `hold` | `hold` = record while held, `toggle` = press to start/stop |
| `autoSend` | `false` | Submit the draft as soon as the transcript is inserted |
| `beep` | `true` | Short tones for start, stop, and failure |
| `language` | *(empty)* | Recognition language hint; empty follows the DSH speech settings |
| `providerId` | *(empty)* | Speech provider id; empty uses the deployment default |
| `minRecordMs` | `150` | Presses shorter than this are rejected with a visible notice |
| `tailMs` | `180` | Audio kept after release, so a fast release does not clip a syllable |
| `maxRecordSeconds` | `60` | Safety stop |
| `debug` | `false` | Keep the keystroke log |

## Diagnostics

Enable **诊断日志** in the popover; each keystroke then records a structured entry,
mirrored to the DevTools console and kept as a 20-entry ring buffer in
`localStorage` (`dsh-dictation-hotkey.log`, copy/clear buttons in the popover).

| `event` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `start` | Microphone ready — `micStartMs`, triggering keys `heldCodes` |
| `stop` | Released — `heldMs`, `tailMs` |
| `ok` | Recognized — `audioSeconds`, `inferenceMs`, `chars`, `peakDb` |
| `empty-transcript` | Engine returned nothing — carries `peakDb`; `quiet: true` means the recording itself was near-silent |
| `skip` | Rejected by a threshold: `shorter than minRecordMs`, `empty audio`, `speech remote absent` |
| `transcribe-failed` / `mic-failed` / `insert-conflict` / `finish-threw` | Corresponding failure |

`peakDb > -45` with an empty transcript points at the recognizer (adjust
`language`); `peakDb < -45` means that take carried no usable sound.

## Development

```sh
npm run build     # build client/dist/client.js (esbuild)
npm run verify    # contract check: the bundle only touches injected services
npm test          # behaviour suite: fake microphone + recognizer
```

`verify.mjs` exists because Cordis throws when a plugin reads a service it did
not declare (`cannot get property "slots" without inject`) while the Web shell
only prints `web boot: 1 entry did not activate` — a diagnostic dead end this
plugin hit once, now a build-time check. `test-release.mjs` covers sloppy release
order, double taps, sub-threshold presses, empty transcripts, and auto-send.

## How it is wired

| Piece | Where |
|---|---|
| Hotkey, microphone, WAV encoding, state | `client/src/{index,controller,hotkey,audio,settings,ui}.js` |
| Composer seat (session-scoped) | `conversation.composer.dock` slot |
| Session-less seat | headless component in the root-scope `shell.overlay` slot |
| Recognition | `ctx.remote.speech.transcribe` — official speech Remote |
| Host half | `host/index.js`, intentionally a no-op (`apply() {}`) |
| Bundle layer | `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the plugin row |

The host half deliberately has no `@deepseek-ai/*` import and no service access:
a profile installs this package through a link, which resolves no dependencies for
it, so a host-side import would abort activation with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and
DSH would refuse to boot the Web GUI.

## Limitations

- Keys are handled while the DSH page is focused. A key pressed with another
  window in front never reaches the plugin; system-wide support needs an OS-level
  helper and is not implemented.
- Microphone permission is granted for the DSH origin. The first ever use may
  require clicking the official microphone button once.
- Recording is capped by `maxRecordSeconds` and by the Remote's own audio limits.

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 AndyYang12345

plugins.description: 我的 dsh 插件清单
plugins.readme_text:
# 我的 DSH 插件清单

此文档列举我个人在 DeepSeek Harness 上使用/维护的 out-of-tree 插件。

| 插件 | 为什么需要它 | profile 兼容性 |
|---|---|---|
| [`dsh-local-policy`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-local-policy) | 它以纯 patch 捆绑（无代码）施加本地部署策略：把框架默认的 web 搜索提供方从 DeepSeek 切换为通用 HTTP 提供方，并禁用 DeepSeek 官方集成与 OTel 会话上报。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；⚠️ sdk-minimal（patch 引用的 entry id 在该独立树中不存在） |
| [`dsh-logger-channels`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-logger-channels) | 它给操作者提供框架与全部插件 `ctx.logger` 输出的可见出口：向 cordis 注册命名通道（stderr/stdout/file，file 通道纯大小轮转），因为宿主只自带内存环形缓冲，没有它日志只进内存。 | ✅ web；其余长驻 profile 原理上可兼容——未验证 |
| [`@openviking/dsh-memory-plugin`](https://github.com/volcengine/OpenViking) | 它给 agent 提供由 OpenViking 支撑的长期记忆：跨会话读写记忆，并在共享同一 OpenViking 的 profile 之间传递上下文。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❓ sdk-minimal（MCP client 可用性未验证） |
| [`dsh-timer`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-timer) | 它给 profile 提供进程内定时任务，语义对齐 systemd.timer，每次运行创建一个新 agent 会话执行任务 prompt。 | ✅ web；⚠️ headless（30s tick 调度器在一次性进程中无意义）；✅ sdk/acp（长驻进程）；❌ sdk-minimal |
| [`dsh-email`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-email) | 它让 agent 能读写邮件：对 IMAP/SMTP 账号提供列目录、搜索、读取、标记、保存附件与发送/回复/转发，并支持新邮件事件触发，使 agent 能实时响应来信。 | ✅ 全部 profile（软读取、优雅降级）；⚠️ headless（IDLE 触发在一次性进程中无意义） |
| [`dsh-ntfy`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-ntfy) | 它给 agent 提供推送通知出口：一次工具调用即把消息发布到 ntfy topic，使作业结果、告警与报告能送达操作者设备或任意订阅该 topic 的应用。| ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`dsh-webhook-dispatcher`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-webhook-dispatcher) | 它给 profile 提供入站 webhook 入口：端点路由挂在框架主 web server 上，外部投递经 method 门控、token 鉴权、请求体大小限制与每端点队列/并发约束后，派发为受控 trigger 会话，使外部系统能触发 agent。 | ✅ web；其余 profile 需组合 `dsh-host-webserver` |
| [`dsh-surfing-plugin`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-surfing-plugin) (forked) | 它为 agent 的联网能力提供后端：允许其接入基于 SearXNG 的搜索与基于 Crawl4AI 的页面抓取。| ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；⚠️ sdk-minimal（无 base web_search） |
| [`dsh-tts`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-tts) | 它让 agent 能合成语音：允许其接入任意 OpenAI 兼容 TTS 后端。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`dsh-imagegen`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-imagegen) | 它让 agent 能生成图像：单个 `imagegen` 工具接入任意 OpenAI 兼容图像后端并渲染图像，并可检查已配置后端及其实时状态。 | ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❌ sdk-minimal（硬依赖 skills 服务） |
| [`@tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-qqbot) (forked) | 它给 profile 提供 QQ IM 通道：维持与 QQ 开放平台的 WS 长连接，处理 QQ 消息的收发与 bot 生命周期，使 agent 能经 QQ 与用户实时交互。 |  ✅ web；❌ headless（一次性进程 + 交互式 QR 绑定）；✅ sdk/acp/sdk-minimal |
| [`dsh-qqbot-send`](https://github.com/xuan25/dsh-qqbot-send) | 它让 agent 能主动把文本、Markdown 或文件附件发送到任意 QQ 目标（私聊/群/频道/公会 DM）；独立调用 QQ 开放平台 REST API，因此可以在没有 qqbot 网关的 profile 中单独挂载。 |  ✅ web/headless/sdk/acp；❓ sdk-minimal |

图例：✅ 兼容 / ⚠️ 可组成功能降级 / ❌ 不兼容 / ❓ 未验证。(forked) = 个人分叉版本。

---

注：除非另有说明，以上插件的自维护版本均使用 QWen3.8-27B groupwise-int 在 DeepSeek Harness 上通过 “Vibe Coding” 产出。软件按“原样”提供，不提供任何形式的明示或暗示的担保。

plugins.description: Every ArtCraft (storytold) crafting app as a DSH plugin — 12 Cordis plugins driving CADCraft, GridCraft, SoundCraft and 9 more headlessly, each over its own CLI and MCP server.
plugins.readme_text:
# ArtCraft × DSH **Twelve crafting applications. One agent. Zero source changes.** Every app from the [ArtCraft](https://github.com/storytold) org — CAD, spreadsheets, audio, video, photo, vector, PDF, slides, documents — exposed to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as a first-class plugin. [![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-4D6BFE?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![built on Cordis](https://img.shields.io/badge/built%20on-Cordis-6E56CF?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT%20OR%20Apache--2.0-blue?style=flat-square)](#license) [![Plugins](https://img.shields.io/badge/plugins-12-success?style=flat-square)](#the-twelve) [![Tools](https://img.shields.io/badge/tools-92-informational?style=flat-square)](#two-surfaces-per-craft) [![MCP](https://img.shields.io/badge/MCP-bridged-8A2BE2?style=flat-square)](#two-surfaces-per-craft) [![Verified](https://img.shields.io/badge/verified-12%2F12-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](#verify-it-yourself) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft?style=flat-square&label=npm&color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft) English · [中文](README.zh.md)
--- ```console $ dsh --profile web you › make me a Q3 sales spreadsheet with a chart, save it to ~/Documents ⏺ gridcraft_commands {"search": "chart"} 315 commands, 8 families ⏺ gridcraft_describe {"id": "insert.chart"} {range?, type?, title?, at?} ⏺ gridcraft_run sample "sales", 2 commands exited 0 in 41ms ⏺ gridcraft_inspect ~/Documents/q3.xlsx 1 sheet, 1 chart, A1:H24 ✔ GridCraft wrote ~/Documents/q3.xlsx (14,208 bytes) ``` ## What this is The ArtCraft suite is twelve native Rust applications. Each one already ships a headless CLI and its own MCP server — but nothing tells an agent they exist, what they can do, or how to call them. This repository closes that gap. Each app becomes a **DSH plugin** that registers model-callable tools on `ctx.tools`, discovers the app's binary on your machine, and drives it as an external process. **No craft source is ever modified.** Every plugin lives here. The applications are dependencies, not forks. ## The twelve | | Craft | What it does | Commands | MCP tools | |:--|:--|:--|--:|--:| | 📐 | **CADCraft** | CAD and drafting (AutoCAD-style) | 305 | 11 | | 📊 | **GridCraft** | Spreadsheets (Excel-style) | 315 | 21 | | 🎚️ | **SoundCraft** | Digital audio workstation | 465 | 17 | | 🖼️ | **PhotoCraft** | Raster image editing (Photoshop-style) | 858 | 21 | | 🌄 | **LightCraft** | Photo library and raw development | 296 | 318 | | 📄 | **PdfCraft** | PDF reading and editing | 161 | 161 | | 🖋️ | **VectorCraft** | Vector art (Illustrator-style) | 743 | 32 | | 🎬 | **EffectCraft** | Motion graphics (After Effects-style) | 669 | 27 | | 🎞️ | **FilmCraft** | Non-linear video editing | 693 | 17 | | 🎨 | **DesignCraft** | Page and layout design (InDesign-style) | 446 | 25 | | 📽️ | **DeckCraft** | Presentations (PowerPoint-style) | 226 | 25 | | 📝 | **WordCraft** | Word processing (Word-style) | 460 | 16 | Command counts are read live from each binary; MCP counts are what each server declares. ## Two surfaces per craft Every plugin exposes **both**, because they answer different questions:
Generic commandsThe craft's own MCP server
Reaches the **entire application** — every menu item is a command id. ``` gridcraft_commands {"search": "chart"} gridcraft_describe {"id": "insert.chart"} gridcraft_run {"commands": [...], "save": "..."} gridcraft_inspect {"file": "..."} gridcraft_convert {"input": "...", "output": "..."} ``` **Modelled operations** with real JSON Schemas, served over JSON-RPC by the app itself. ``` gridcraft_mcp_tools {"search": "range"} gridcraft_mcp_call {"tool": "write_range", "arguments": {"range": "A1", "values": [["x"]]}} gridcraft_mcp_status {} ```
The MCP server is spawned once per plugin and kept warm — starting GridCraft's engine costs ~600 ms — then shut down after five idle minutes or when the plugin unloads. ## Quick start **Windows** — from a fresh clone, in PowerShell: ```powershell git clone https://github.com/lznnnnn1998/dsh-artcraft cd dsh-artcraft .\install.ps1 # or: install.cmd (if .ps1 files are blocked) ``` That finds the Node the harness already ships (no `node`, `npm` or `pnpm` on `PATH` needed), downloads every craft CLI for your platform, and installs the twelve plugins into your DSH profile. Add `-Crafts gridcraft` for one craft, `-List` for a dry run, or `-Verify` to prove it works: ```powershell .\install.ps1 -Crafts gridcraft,wordcraft -Profile desktop -Verify ``` **macOS and Linux** — the same two steps by hand: ```sh git clone https://github.com/lznnnnn1998/dsh-artcraft cd dsh-artcraft # 1. the craft CLIs — macOS, Windows and Linux, no Rust toolchain needed node scripts/install-craft.mjs # …or compile them from source instead (needs Rust, ~1 min per craft): # node scripts/install-craft.mjs --from-source # 2. install the plugins into a DSH profile, then restart it node scripts/install-into-profile.mjs --profile web ``` Both platforms run the same Node scripts; `install.ps1` only adds Node discovery and PowerShell-friendly defaults. Nothing is installed machine-wide and no shell profile is modified. Or install a single craft from npm, straight into a profile: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artcraft-plugin-gridcraft ``` Each craft is its own package: `dsh-artcraft-plugin-` for `cadcraft`, `gridcraft`, `soundcraft`, `deckcraft`, `wordcraft`, `photocraft`, `lightcraft`, `pdfcraft`, `vectorcraft`, `effectcraft`, `filmcraft` and `designcraft`. Then just ask: > *"Open the CADCraft sample floor plan and export a PNG of the kitchen."* > *"Take the demo song in SoundCraft, drop the kick 6 dB and bounce it."* > *"Render page 3 of this PDF at 300 dpi."* Full instructions, configuration and troubleshooting: **[docs/INSTALL.md](docs/INSTALL.md)**
Requirements - **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` — on Windows the harness's own bundled Node is found automatically, so you do not need it on `PATH` - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) profile - **macOS, Windows 11 or Ubuntu 24.04** — the installer picks the right build, and nothing else is required (no Rust, no `unzip`, no `tar`, no `npm`, no `pnpm`) Nothing else. The craft apps are **not** built from source; step 1 downloads signed release binaries.
## Verify it yourself ```sh node scripts/verify.mjs ``` Every craft must locate its binary, load its live catalog, expose the right tool set, complete an MCP handshake, and produce a non-empty artifact from a real headless run: ``` craft binary catalog tools mcp run cadcraft cadcraft-cli 0.5.0 305 (live) 8 11 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.dxf (34140 B) deckcraft deckcraft-cli 0.5.0 226 (live) 8 25 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.deckcraft (7471 B) designcraft designcraft-cli 0.6.0 446 (live) 6 25 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.pdf (2028 B) effectcraft effectcraft-cli 0.8.0 669 (live) 8 27 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.ecproj (732438 B) filmcraft filmcraft-cli 0.6.0 693 (live) 8 17 tools (command_list ok) ok → out.fcproj (3264 B) gridcraft gridcraft-cli 0.5.0 315 (live) 8 21 tools (list_commands ok) ok → out.xlsx (7682 B) lightcraft lightcraft-cli 0.6.0 296 (live) 7 318 tools (command_list ok) ok → out.bin (108535 B) pdfcraft pdfcraft-cli 0.7.1 161 (live) 8 161 tools (doc_list ok) ok → out.pdf (802 B) photocraft photocraft-c

# dsh-delivery-receipt（交付回执）

给 DeepSeek Harness 的**交付回执**插件：项目收尾时按一下，把「分支与 commit、测试与构建结果、
关键截图尺寸与 sha256、密钥扫描结论」汇成一张可以拿出去给人看的页面 —— 并且把每一条声明
**硬性**分进「已验证 / 仅本地 / 未验证」三区。**没有证据的板块留空，不补话。**

## 为什么要有它

收尾汇报每次都要手写一遍：写少了漏证据，写多了越界（把"我这台机器上是这样"说成"已经交付"）。
生态里的状态类插件（`2008924/dsh-progress-viz`、`133563825as-ai/dsh-api-dashboard`）都是**给自己看的实时面板**；
名字相近的 `dsh-receipt` 系列（如 `bluechips-zhao/dsh-receipt`、`louisyeaaah/dsh-receipt`）是**会话/用量小票**（token、耗时、成本、热敏打印）。
它们都不回答"这份交付里，哪几条是别人能复现的，哪几条只在你机器上成立"。

这个插件把这件事变成一条可测试的规则：

| 区 | 判定（只看证据，不看措辞，也不看成败） |
|---|---|
| **已验证** | 证据来自本次采集且能在别处复现：命令确实跑了（退出码就是事实）、文件哈希且文件已入版本库、扫描确实扫到了文件、git 引用在本地记录的远端里 |
| **仅本地** | 只在这台机器上成立：未提交改动、未推送提交、交付物未被 git 跟踪（别人拿到仓库看不到这个哈希） |
| **未验证** | 没有证据或证据不足：命令没运行/超时、声明的文件不存在、扫描 0 个文件、以及**人写的任何一句话** |

> ⚠️ **「已验证」不等于「是好消息」**：测试失败、密钥扫描命中都是**有证据的事实**，同样进已验证区，只是带红色色调。
> 三区分的是**证据强度**，不是成败。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-delivery-receipt
```

也可以从 GitHub 直装：`dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add github:dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-delivery-receipt`。
装好后重启 DSH，对话视图里出现「交付回执」Tab。

## 配置：`delivery-receipt.json`（放在项目根）

```json
{
  "project": "my-project",
  "tests":   [{ "name": "单元测试", "command": "node --test test/*.test.mjs" }],
  "builds":  [{ "name": "构建", "command": "node scripts/build.mjs" }],
  "artifacts": ["docs/*.png"],
  "scan": { "ignore": ["docs/big-demo.html"] },
  "claims": [{ "label": "已内部评审", "value": "2026-10-12 通过" }],
  "runCommands": true
}
```

| 字段 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `tests` / `builds` | 生成回执时会**执行**并把退出码、通过数、耗时写进回执。写法可以是字符串或 `{name, command}` |
| `artifacts` | 交付物模式：精确路径或 `目录/*.png`。会记录字节数、sha256、图片尺寸、以及**是否已入版本库** |
| `scan.ignore` | 密钥扫描跳过的路径前缀 |
| `scan.allowMarker` | 逐行豁免标记，默认 `delivery-receipt:allow`。测试夹具、文档示例这类"像凭据但不是凭据"的行，在行尾写上标记即可豁免；**豁免了多少行会原样出现在回执里**，不是静默放过 |
| `claims` | 你要说的话。**永远进未验证区** —— 能附证据的东西应该写成上面那些字段 |
| `runCommands` | 默认 `true`；设 `false` 只采集不执行 |
| `cwd` | 可选：覆盖采集目录（相对路径按配置文件所在目录解析） |

## 用法

装好插件后：对话视图 →「交付回执」→ 点「生成回执」。面板会先列出**这次会执行哪些命令**，
再按三区展示结果；「打开回执页」给出自包含的 HTML（可直接存文件/发出去），「复制 Markdown」给 PR 或聊天用。

不装 DSH 也能用：

```sh
node scripts/receipt.mjs                     # 打印摘要
node scripts/receipt.mjs --out receipt.html  # 落盘自包含页面
node scripts/receipt.mjs --md                # 打印 Markdown
node scripts/receipt.mjs --no-run            # 只采集，不执行命令
```

本仓库自己的回执（dogfood，含真实的 sha256 与扫描结论）：[docs/receipt-example.md](docs/receipt-example.md)

![回执页：三区并列，每条声明都带证据行](docs/screenshot-1.png)

> 图是**快照**：截图文件自身的 sha256 每拍一次都会变，所以图里「交付物」那一行永远比当前文件慢一代。
> 权威数据看 [docs/receipt-example.md](docs/receipt-example.md)（它记录的是它自己那一刻的仓库状态，含生成时间与 commit）。

## HTTP 接口

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/state` | 当前配置、将要执行的命令、上次回执摘要 |
| POST | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/generate` | 生成一次回执（body 可带 `{"cwd": "..."}`，但必须在白名单内） |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.html` | 自包含回执页（未生成时是明确的"还没有"页） |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.md` | 同一份内容的 Markdown |
| GET | `/dsh-delivery-receipt/receipt.json` | 回执对象（未生成时 404） |

## 安全边界（重要）

- **要执行的命令只来自配置文件**（`delivery-receipt.json` 或插件配置的 `receiptConfig`），
  **永远不来自 HTTP 请求**。`test/host.test.mjs` 里有一条测试专门往请求体塞 `command` 和假的 `tests`，断言执行器一次都没被调用。
- **能采集的目录只来自插件配置**：`cwd` 与 `roots` 白名单。请求里带的 `cwd` 不在白名单内一律 403 且不采集。
- **不联网**：远端状态读本地的 `refs/remotes/origin/*`，回执里标注为「本地记录的远端状态」，不把离线缓存说成实时事实。
- **不落凭据**：密钥扫描命中只记录 `文件:行号 + 规则名`，匹配到的内容、长度、摘要都不写；所有进入页面的文本再过一次脱敏（`ghp_…`、`sk-…`、私钥块、内联 Bearer、赋值型口令），家目录归一成 `~`。仓库里有一条测试断言"密钥字符串及其前缀不出现在序列化结果里"。
- **夹具误报有出口，而且不是静默的**：测试里必然会出现"像凭据的字符串"，所以扫描支持逐行豁免标记（默认 `delivery-receipt:allow`）。豁免的行数会写进回执的扫描范围一栏 —— 你可以看到放过了 3 行，而不是被瞒着。
- **自包含**：回执页没有外链脚本、没有 CDN、没有追踪（有测试断言 `<link>`/`<script>`/外链 `src|href` 都不存在），所以它可以离线保存、当附件发出去。

## 它不做什么

- **不判断好坏**：测试失败、扫描命中照样进「已验证」，插件的职责是把事实和证据分级，不是替你做结论。
- **不替你核实远端**：不联网，也没法知道远端仓库是否 public、tag 是否推上去了 —— 这类声明会落在「仅本地」或「未验证」。
- **不补话**：某个板块没有证据就是空的，页面会写「此区无证据」而不是编一段过渡句。
- **不是安全审计**：内置正则覆盖常见凭据形态（GitHub/npm/sk-/AWS/GCP/Slack/私钥/内联 Bearer/赋值型口令 + 敏感文件名），
  跳过大文件与二进制；它降低"把凭据一起发出去"的概率，不等于完备扫描。

## 开发

```sh
node scripts/build.mjs   # 零依赖构建（不需要打包器），产出 lib/
node --test              # 64 个测试
```

测试分四组：`evidence`（git 解析 / 图片尺寸 / 哈希 / 扫描 / 配置）、`zones`（三区判定规则）、
`receipt`（渲染与脱敏）、`host`（用 stub ctx 驱动真实 `apply()`，含两条安全边界）。
`lib/` 是构建产物，改 `src/` 后必须重新 build。

## 本仓库自身的状态（诚实披露）

- ✅ 已验证：`node --test` 64/64 通过、`node scripts/build.mjs` 退出 0、密钥扫描 0 命中（见 [回执](docs/receipt-example.md)）。
- ⚠️ 未验证：**没有在运行中的 DSH 里安装加载过** —— host/client 半区只经过单元测试与构建校验，
  没有端到端跑过真实宿主；面板截图一栏用的是 CLI 生成的回执页，不是 DSH 面板。
- ✅ 参考与差异：工程骨架照抄同作者的 [`dsh-warden`](https://github.com/dingchenhui0618-arch/dsh-warden)
  （零依赖构建、`cordis.patch.yml`、host/client 双半区、README、测试结构），这是明确授权的骨架复用；
  **实现代码没有搬运任何现有插件**。上面提到的 `dsh-progress-viz` / `dsh-api-dashboard` / `dsh-receipt`
  系列只读了它们的仓库简介，用来说明本插件与它们的差异。

## License

plugins.description: Config-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that mounts the in-box MCP client bridge against CursorTouch/Windows-MCP: no plugin code, 16 of the 21 upstream tools by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-windows-mcp-lite

**Config-only bridge from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) to [CursorTouch/Windows-MCP](https://github.com/CursorTouch/Windows-MCP).**

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

It mounts the MCP client bridge that already ships inside DeepSeek Harness and points it at the upstream Windows-MCP server over stdio. The whole integration is [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) — about 25 lines, no JavaScript, and you can read it to the end before you install it.

```text
DSH agent
  └─ mcp__windows__Snapshot / Click / Type / ...
       └─ @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client        (ships with DeepSeek Harness)
            └─ uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve   (stdio child process)
                 └─ your desktop: UI Automation tree, Win32 input, screen capture
```

## What this deliberately does not do

These are the design decisions, not a missing-feature list:

- **No Host plugin.** There is no `index.js`. Nothing of ours runs inside your harness process.
- **No web routes.** This plugin adds no HTTP endpoint, so it adds no unauthenticated attack surface and no reason to keep your web host on loopback beyond what you already chose.
- **No state file.** No `~/.dsh/...state.json`, no browser storage keys.
- **No installer that writes to your profile.** `npm run prewarm` installs and verifies the upstream server *in your own terminal*, and never edits a profile patch for you.
- **No runtime dependency and no build step.** `dependencies` is empty; there is nothing to compile and no `allowBuilds` approval to grant.
- **No absolute path for your machine.** The bridge invokes `uvx` from `PATH`; a test in this repo fails the build if a machine-specific path appears in a published file.
- **No `peerDependencies`.** The row *names* `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`; it never imports it, and DSH resolves shipped packages from its own installation. This follows DSH's own `templates/mcp` bundle shape, which declares none. A peer range would be a hard activation gate whose SemVer prerelease rules silently reject valid hosts; `engines.dsh` declares the host range for the storefront instead.
- **No `screenshots.json`.** There is no interface to photograph. Declaring artwork for a configuration file would be decoration, not evidence; the storefront falls back to whatever it can extract.

If you want an in-app dependency installer, a default-off "Computer Use" toggle, or a doctor tool, other plugins in this ecosystem provide those. This one trades them for being small enough to audit in one screen — which matters more than usual for a plugin that hands over your keyboard, mouse and screen.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10 or 11.** The upstream server is Windows-only.
- **DeepSeek Harness with the in-box MCP client bridge.** Declared range: `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`; the author verified this plugin on **0.2.0-rc.2** (desktop).
- **[uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) on the `PATH` of the process that runs DSH.** `uvx` starts the upstream server and builds its isolated environment. If you installed uv with its official installer, this is already true.
- Optional: **a model that accepts image input**, if you want `Screenshot` to arrive as a real image. Without it the bridge degrades the image to a text diagnostic; `Snapshot` returns plain text and needs no vision at all.

## Install

From the app: **Settings → Plugins → Add plugin**, and enter one of

```text
dsh-windows-mcp-lite                                # npm package
github:sheilacraig/dsh-windows-mcp-lite             # GitHub repository
C:\path\to\a\local\checkout                         # absolute path
```

From a CLI-owned profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-windows-mcp-lite
```

The Electron desktop profile belongs to the app; install through its plugin panel there.

Then restart DSH, so the new patch layer composes at startup.

## First run is the slow one

`uvx` builds an isolated environment for the upstream server the first time, which downloads a few tens of megabytes of Python dependencies. On a slow link that is minutes, and the bridge gives up on the initial connection long before that; after the dependencies are cached, startup is quick.

Do it outside the harness instead, where there is no timeout:

```sh
npm run prewarm
```

The script runs `uvx windows-mcp@0.8.8 serve --exclude-tools ...` — the same argv the bridge uses — speaks `initialize` + `tools/list` to it, prints the server identity, the time it took, and the exact tool list, then exits. It is the same process the bridge will start, so a successful run means the harness side has nothing left to download or discover. With the environment warm, the author's run reached `initialize` in 2.1 s.

## What the model gets

**16 tools**, named `mcp__windows__<Tool>`. Upstream 0.8.8 publishes 21; this plugin excludes five by default (see [Least privilege](#least-privilege-by-default)).

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `Screenshot` | Screen capture with cursor position and window list |
| `Snapshot` | Full desktop state: accessibility tree, interactive elements, scrollable regions |
| `DisplayInventory` | Display layout, work areas, DPI |
| `Click`, `Move`, `Scroll` | Mouse input, including explicit drag |
| `Type`, `Shortcut` | Keyboard input |
| `Wait`, `WaitFor` | Fixed delay, or poll the UI until a condition holds |
| `MultiSelect`, `MultiEdit` | Bulk selection / bulk text entry |
| `Clipboard` | Read and set clipboard content |
| `Notification` | Windows toast notifications |
| `App` | Launch an application, resize or focus a window |
| `ControlStatus` | Who owns the desktop right now — upstream cannot exclude this one |

## Verify

1. Run `npm run prewarm` once (above). It proves the server and the pinned version.
2. In DSH, ask the agent to call `mcp__windows__DisplayInventory`. It only reads display geometry — it does not click or type.
3. Then `mcp__windows__Snapshot` for the accessibility tree as text.

## Least privilege by default

`--exclude-tools PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape` — five upstream tools stay off, because DeepSeek Harness already owns shell, file, registry and process access under its own approval policy and sandbox. Enabling upstream's copies would add a second path to the same capabilities with none of those controls.

To change the set, override the row in your profile patch (see below). Removing `--exclude-tools` restores all 21 tools.

## Configuration

Every default lives in [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml). To change one, override the row in **your profile's** patch — do not edit the installed copy:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- id: windows-mcp-lite
  config:
    serverName: windows
    transport: stdio
    command: uvx
    args: [windows-mcp@0.8.8, serve, --exclude-tools, "PowerShell,Registry,FileSystem,Process,Scrape,App"]
    toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    failOnStartupError: true
    env:
      ANONYMIZED_TELEMETRY: "false"
      WINDOWS_MCP_DISABLE_FLASH: "1"
```

Two things about that override, both of which cost people time:

- **A patch replaces the entire `config` object; it does not deep-merge.** Every key you leave out is a key you delete. `serverName` and `transport` are required, `command` is required for `stdio`, `url` for `streamable-http`.
- **`serverName` decides every tool name** (`mcp__<serverName>__<tool>`). Changing it renames the whole tool set and invalidates prompt-cache prefixes.

**Only one Windows-MCP bridge per profile.** Two rows using the same `serverName` conflict, and the second one fails at load. Disable any other Windows-MCP plugin in the same profile before enabling this one.

Prefer a pre-installed interpreter over `uvx`? `uv tool install windows-mcp`, then set `command: windows-mcp` with `args: [serve, --exclude-tools, ...]`. Prefer a resident HTTP server? Switch `transport` to `streamable-http` and give `url` — note that the HTTP form has no `env`, so telemetry and flash settings then belong to how you start the server.

## Security

Installing this gives an agent your mouse, keyboard, clipboard and screen, through a process that runs with your user rights. Judge it as "

# dsh-motor-ai

电机设计完整版插件（L1/L2），基于 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 框架。

## 架构

```
dsh-motor-ai-core      ← 共享核心（公式引擎、代理模型、经验回灌等）
├── dsh-motor-ai-l0    ← 免费版（L0 公式通道）
└── dsh-motor-ai       ← 完整版（L0 + L1 RMxprt + L2 Motor-CAD）
```

## 安装

**方式一：DSH 界面直装（不走市场）**

DSH Desktop →「添加和管理插件」→ 输入框填：

```
dsh-motor-ai@1.0.0-rc.7
```

> - **必须带 `@版本`**：安装器用 `spec.lastIndexOf('@')` 切分包名与版本，纯包名会把版本算错。
> - 也可填 GitHub 仓库地址（需仓库真实存在）或本地目录路径。
> - full 与 `dsh-motor-ai-l0` **互斥**，安装前请先在「已安装」里卸载 l0。
> - 本插件自带组合包配置（`package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` → `./cordis.patch.yml`），
>   这是 DSH 界面能识别并安装它的前提。

**方式二：命令行**

```bash
# 完整版（需先卸载免费版，两者互斥）
npm uninstall dsh-motor-ai-l0
npm install dsh-motor-ai@next
```

> **当前版本口径**：`latest` = `1.0.0-beta`；`1.0.0-rc.7` 为预发布，走 `next` 标签。
> 稳定版发布后 `@next` 可省略。

## 配置

插件**自带**的默认配置在包内 `cordis.patch.yml`（由 `package.json` 的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 声明）。
用户级覆盖写在 **profile 的** `cordis.patch.yml` 里，按 `id` 覆盖 `config`：

```yaml
- id: dsh-motor-ai
  config:
    level: l2        # l0 / l1 / l2
    l1Enabled: true  # 启用 RMxprt 求解
    l2Enabled: false # Motor-CAD 暂不启用
```

> 无论 `level` 如何设置，**L0 永久免费可用**；L1/L2 工具恒注册，**调用时**按激活码门控。

## 工具

| 层级 | 工具 | 描述 | 状态 |
|------|------|------|------|
| L0 | motor_param_matrix | 参数矩阵生成 | ✅ |
| L0 | motor_l0_estimate | 公式效率估算 | ✅ |
| L0 | motor_design_validate | 设计校验 | ✅ |
| L0 | motor_l0_pipeline | L0 全流程 | ✅ |
| L1 | motor_l1_estimate | RMxprt 估算 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 AEDT |
| L1 | motor_l1_pipeline | RMxprt 批处理 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 AEDT |
| L1 | motor_rmxprt_solve | RMxprt 单解 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 AEDT |
| L2 | motor_l2_validate | 几何校验 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 Motor-CAD |
| L2 | motor_motorcad_verify | COM 验证 | ⚙️ 随包分发，需本机 Motor-CAD |
| 通用 | motor_env_check | L1/L2 环境一键体检 + 修复引导 | ✅ 免费、不占配额 |

> **求解器依赖说明（rc.11 起）**：L1/L2 的求解器脚本已随包分发（`scripts/_rmxprt_venv_worker.py` / `scripts/motorcad_bridge.py`），装完即可用；但**本机仍需安装对应商业求解器**：
> - **L1**：Ansys AEDT 2020.x（RMxprt）+ Python 3.10 环境装有 `pyaedt 0.6.x` 或 `pywin32`；解释器路径用 `PYTHON_BIN` 指定，worker 可用 `RMXPRT_WORKER_PATH` 覆盖（默认用包内副本）
> - **L2**：Motor-CAD v11.1.5（`MotorCAD.AppAutomation`）+ Python 3.10 环境装有 `pywin32`；路径用 `MOTORCAD_PATH` / `MOTORCAD_INSTALL_DIR` 指定
> 未装求解器时调用返回结构化错误引导，不影响 L0。
>
> **环境自动搜寻与引导（rc.12 起）**：授权通过后，L1/L2 真解算前会自动体检五项环境（Python / pyaedt / pywin32 / AEDT / Motor-CAD）——缺失项直接返回人话修复指引（下载页 / pip 命令 / 环境变量 / 配置键），**不会白耗 60-120s 的 AEDT/COM 启动，也不扣当日配额**。任何时候都可用 `motor_env_check` 一键体检（免费、不占配额）。

## 互斥规则

- 完整版与免费版**不能同时安装**
- 升级时需先 `npm uninstall dsh-motor-ai-l0`

## 开发

```bash
# 运行验证
npm run verify

# 运行测试
npm test

## 激活（L1/L2 解锁）

`dsh-motor-ai` 按 **PolyForm-Noncommercial-1.0** 分发：非商业免费装；商业使用需激活码（收费墙是许可约束，不是代码锁）。

### 分层与状态

| 层 | 工具 | 状态 |
|----|------|------|
| L0 | `motor_param_matrix` / `motor_l0_estimate` / `motor_design_validate` / `motor_l0_pipeline` | ✅ 免费即用 |
| L1 | `motor_l1_estimate` / `motor_l1_pipeline` / `motor_rmxprt_solve` | 🔒 需激活 |
| L2 | `motor_l2_validate` / `motor_motorcad_verify` | 🔒 需激活 |

### 分级启用

在 `cordis.patch.yml`（DSH profile）中：

```yaml
plugins:
  dsh-motor-ai:
    level: l1          # l0 / l1 / l2
    l1Enabled: true    # 启用 RMxprt 求解
    l2Enabled: false   # Motor-CAD 暂不启用
```

默认 `level: l0`，仅 L0 免费工具可用。

### 激活流程

1. 向作者获取激活码（私域渠道，形如 `v2:full:wangxue98:<buyer_b64>:<ts>:<exp>:<sig128>`）
2. 在 DSH 对话中运行命令：`/dsh-motor-ai-activate <code>`
3. 回显 `✅ 激活成功！当前层级: FULL`，`motor_l1_*` / `motor_l2_*` 即解锁
4. 激活状态落盘 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-motor-ai/activation.json`
5. 未激活时调 L1/L2：返回 `LICENSE_REQUIRED` 结构化引导（含联系邮箱，不会崩，L0 照常可用）

### 作者自测签码（非对称 Ed25519）

激活码用 **Ed25519 非对称签名**：公钥随包发布，私钥作者自持。

```bash
# 1) 生成密钥对：公钥写 lib/activation-public.pem（随包），私钥写 .secrets/activation-private.pem（绝不入库/不随包）
node scripts/mint-activation-code.mjs --genkey --write-secret

# 2) 签发 full 测试码（私钥来源：--key > ACTIVATION_PRIVATE_KEY 环境变量 > .secrets/activation-private.pem）
node scripts/mint-activation-code.mjs --type full --issuer wangxue98 --buyer 15389089358@163.com
# 输出形如 v2:full:wangxue98:<b64>:<ts>:<exp>:<128hex-sig>
```

把上一步的码在 DSH 对话里 `/dsh-motor-ai-activate <code>` 即可解锁。

### 非对称验签机制

- **v2（默认）**：Ed25519。发布包内置公钥（`lib/license.mjs` 常量 + `lib/activation-public.pem`），部署出去即可验签，**外部买家可被真实放行**；私钥仅作者持有，用于签码。
- **密钥隔离**：私钥在 `.secrets/`（`.gitignore` 排除，且不在 `package.json` 的 `files` 白名单），**不会进入 npm 发布包**；公钥公开，随包无泄露风险。
- **v1（兼容）**：旧的 HMAC 对称码（`ACTIVATION_HMAC_KEY`）仍可验，但已废弃，新签码一律 v2。

### 端到端自检

```bash
node scripts/_activate_selftest.mjs   # 临时 DSH_HOME 隔离，覆盖未激活拦截/签发激活/降档/伪造/篡改/过期/格式容错
```

## 商业授权

本插件按 **PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0** 许可分发：个人及非商业用途可免费使用；商业用途需获取商业授权。

- **L0（公式通道）对所有用户永久免费，无需激活码。**
- L1（RMxprt）/ L2（Motor-CAD）为完整版付费层，需激活码解锁。
- 激活码**只锁 L1/L2，绝不锁 L0**；无码、码过期或码无效时，插件照常加载、L0 全部可用，仅在调用 L1/L2 时返回引导。

商业授权报价与采购，请联系：**13546196530@163.com**
```

plugins.readme_text: # DeepSeek Harness English | [中文](README.zh.md) This community repository hosts the openUBMC integration for DeepSeek Harness. To install it into official DSH, use the [prebuilt plugin release](https://github.com/lihuabai629-star/deepseek-harness-openubmc/releases/tag/openubmc-plugin-v0.2.0) and [plugin installation guide](scripts/openubmc/distribution/README.md). DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) is an open-source agent harness developed by [DeepSeek AI](https://deepseek.com). It is built on an **everything-is-a-plugin** architecture and powered by [Cordis](https://github.com/cordiverse/cordis), whose design is described in [_A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability_](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.25512). Documentation: [https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) ## Developer preview DeepSeek Harness is in _developer preview_ and iterating rapidly. **THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES.** Review the [safety notice](SAFETY.md) before running the project. ## Run ### Run from `npm` Install `Node.js`, then run: ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web ``` The command starts the Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080` by default and opens it in the default browser for a local launch. An SSH launch only prints the host URL because the SSH client or editor owns the local forwarded address. Pass `--no-open` to run the server without opening a browser. See [Web UI guide](docs/user/guide/index.md). ### Run from source To run from a repository checkout: ```sh git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git cd deepseek-harness pnpm install pnpm run build pnpm dsh web ``` `pnpm run build` prepares the repository artifacts. `pnpm dsh web` uses those built artifacts without rebuilding. ## Community and support - Submit feedback or bug reports through [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions). - Add the [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic to your plugin repository for discoverability. - Join DeepSeek Harness Discord community. ## Contributing See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Development Start with the [development guide](docs/development.md) and [architecture documentation](docs/architecture.md). `pnpm run dev:web` builds, serves, and rebuilds client bundles on source edits in one terminal, and `make help` lists the matching Make targets for Web and Desktop; the guide's application commands section owns the full table. For agents, follow [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md). ## Citation ```bibtex @misc{deepseek-harness2026, title={DeepSeek Harness: Everything is a Plugin}, author={DeepSeek-AI}, year={2026}, publisher={GitHub}, howpublished={\url{https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness}}, } ``` ## License [MIT](LICENSE) Third-party dependencies and their licenses are disclosed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).

plugins.description: Theme-aware click effects for DeepSeek Harness — gold ripples, stars, five languages, macOS/Windows/Linux.
plugins.readme_text:
# Atelier Click FX · 工坊星涟 English | [简体中文](README.zh.md) [![CI](https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/actions/workflows/ci.yml) ![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%3E%3D0.2.0--rc.2-526aa8) ![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-c5a468)

A small, independent visual plugin for **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and Desktop**. Mouse clicks randomly alternate between **five distinct animations**: star ripples, lace blossoms, comet showers, orbiting stars and fluttering butterflies. Each uses the current theme’s soft gold, porcelain white and periwinkle blue, then fades in **0.72–0.9 seconds**. Designed to complement the navy, gold and lace of **Maid Atelier / 深海女仆工坊**. It reads the active skin's colors and ships no third-party skin artwork. It uses the same native DSH package, profile-patch and browser-module conventions as the [dsh-web-all family](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web), but is an independent plugin and is not bundled with that project. ## Install Requires DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** with its `dsh` command available on PATH. Desktop users can register the command through the app's command-management menu. No separate model, API key, native build tools or plugin dependencies are needed. **Desktop:** fully quit the application, then run the following in Terminal, PowerShell or your Linux shell: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/releases/download/v1.2.0/dsh-atelier-clickfx-1.2.0.tgz" ``` Restart the desktop app. In **Plugins**, enable **Atelier Click FX** (its title follows your UI language; package ID: `dsh-atelier-clickfx`). **Web GUI:** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/releases/download/v1.2.0/dsh-atelier-clickfx-1.2.0.tgz" dsh web ``` Restart an already running Web server. The quoted release URL works unchanged across macOS, Windows PowerShell and Linux. Use your actual profile name if you maintain a custom profile. Alternatively, download the `.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/releases), add its absolute path in DSH's plugin installer, or install the tagged source: ```sh dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx#v1.2.0" ``` The repository contains ready-to-load JavaScript; installing it does not run a build script. Releases include a `SHA256SUMS.txt` for the packaged artifact. This release is distributed through GitHub, not the npm registry. ## Behavior - A short primary mouse or pen click creates one approximately 110 CSS-pixel effect. - A shuffled bag plays all five effects once in each group of five accepted clicks; adjacent groups never repeat the same effect at their boundary. Dragged, long or rate-limited clicks do not consume a choice. - The effects differ in shape and motion, not just color. Their palette is sampled from the active skin on every click. - Drags, long presses, secondary buttons and touchscreen scrolling do not trigger it. - The overlay never intercepts input or takes focus. No sound, cursor trail or idle animation. - At most eight effects coexist; rapid clicks are rate-limited. The canvas backing buffer is capped at approximately eight million pixels. - Effects clear when the app loses focus, becomes hidden or resizes. - **Reduce Motion** is respected immediately: no effects play while that preference is enabled. - Disabling the plugin disposes its canvas, event listeners and animation frame. - No network calls, telemetry, model usage, storage access or persistent click history. ### Five animations | Effect | Shape and movement | Duration | | --- | --- | --- | | Star ripple | Fine circular waves with outward-drifting four-point stars | 720 ms | | Lace blossom | A delicate six-petal flower outline opening outward | 820 ms | | Comet shower | A small cluster of stars with short, fading trajectories | 760 ms | | Star orbit | Stars following tilted elliptical rings | 900 ms | | Butterfly flutter | Light butterfly outlines gently flapping and drifting outward | 860 ms | ## Languages The DSH plugin list title and description, plus the standalone preview, support **English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Russian**. DSH metadata lives in `locale/*.json`, including `zh` and `zh-CN` aliases. The animation contains no text and works with any UI language. The production plugin follows the host's locale resolution; the preview has its own language selector and browser-language default. English is the metadata fallback. Do not change the package ID or module registration ID when translating display text. ## Platforms and verification | Platform | Runtime design | Validation | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | DSH Desktop or Web GUI | Actual Desktop click rendering, input focus and navigation verified | | Windows | DSH Desktop where available, or Web GUI | Node 22/24 automated CI; native UI not manually tested | | Linux | DSH Desktop where available, or Web GUI | Node 22/24 automated CI; native UI not manually tested | The plugin uses browser Canvas and Pointer Events and contains no OS-specific commands, filesystem paths or native modules. The [CI matrix](https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/actions/workflows/ci.yml) checks JavaScript syntax, package/locale integrity, host loading and lifecycle behavior on all three operating systems. These checks use a simulated DOM/Canvas; they are not a substitute for native UI testing. ## Theme integration Colors are sampled on each click, so a skin change does not require restarting the effect: | Role | Preferred token | Fallback | | --- | --- | --- | | Warm outlines and stars | `--maid-gold-soft`, then `--maid-gold` | `#e2cfaa` | | Blue accents and particles | `--maid-periwinkle`, then `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` | `#8ea5da` | | Porcelain highlights | `--maid-porcelain`, then `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | `#f8f6f0` | The plugin remains usable without Maid Atelier or dsh-web-all. It does not edit either package, add settings panels or change the selected skin. It decorates the renderer's content area, not the operating system's title bar, menus or dialogs. ## Develop and preview ```sh git clone https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx.git cd dsh-atelier-clickfx npm run check npm test npm run pack:check npm pack ``` No dependency installation is required. Open `preview.html` in a modern browser for an interactive demo using the **same `client.js`** as DSH. The preview’s demo button plays five randomly selected clicks using the same shuffled sequence; it also respects Reduce Motion. `index.js` is the deliberately empty host entry; `client.js` registers a lazy browser module with DSH and owns all effects through `ctx.effect`. `cordis.patch.yml` adds one independently toggleable row. Public package metadata is exported through `package.json` and `locale/*`. ## Disable or remove Turn off **Atelier Click FX** in DSH's Plugins page. To remove it, use the plugin's normal uninstall action. Restart the host if prompted. There is no plugin data directory to clean up. ## License [MIT](LICENSE). All artwork shipped in this repository is original to this plugin. The reference skin and dsh-web-all remain their authors' separate projects.

plugins.description: AI 街机厅 for DeepSeek Harness — 模型负责「想」、本地引擎负责「动」（双脑贪吃蛇 + 中国象棋）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-ai-arcade

**AI 街机厅** —— 在 [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek.com/harness/en/) 里玩游戏，对手是有脑子的：**模型负责「想」，本地引擎负责「动」**。

点左下角的 🎮 打开面板，里面是一个完整的街机厅。

| 游戏 | 模型做什么 | 本地做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 🐍 **双脑贪吃蛇** | 每 1.7 秒出一张**策略卡**（目标 / 激进程度 / 风险偏好）+ 一句挑衅 | 按 60fps 跑规则、按策略卡决定每一步、模型慢或挂了自动兜底 |
| ♟ **中国象棋** | 只**解说**（从引擎给的候选里挑一个 + 说一句心理活动） | 走法生成、合法性校验、alpha-beta 搜索 —— **全部棋力** |

## 为什么模型不直接下棋 / 不直接控制蛇

因为它做不到，而且实测数据很清楚：

- **象棋**：马腿、象眼、炮架、将帅照面这些规则一旦交给模型，非法棋是常态；就算合法，几百行的搜索也轻松赢它。所以模型只被允许**从本地给出的合法候选里挑一个**——非法棋因此不可能出现。
- **贪吃蛇**：单次模型往返 **0.8–2 秒**，而游戏一步只要 140 毫秒。所以模型只出**意图**，具体走法由本地引擎算。
- **还有一个坑**：宿主默认的 `reasoningEffort` 是 `high`，实测一次游戏规模的提问会**烧掉 2048 个输出 token 全在思考块里、耗时 17 秒、正文为空**。这个插件显式要 `off`，同样的提问变成 **0.78 秒、37 个 token、回答完整**。

断网、模型超时、额度用尽 —— 两个游戏都照常运行，只是少了那张嘴。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-ai-arcade
```

装好后点界面左下角的 **🎮**。

## 配置

写在 profile 补丁层，或直接在设置页改：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-ai-arcade
      name: dsh-ai-arcade
      config:
        enabled: true
        provider: deepseek-account   # 留空则自动挑第一个可用 provider
        model: deepseek-flash
        reasoningEffort: "off"       # 游戏要快；深度复盘时可以单独覆盖
        maxTokens: 2048
        timeoutMs: 45000
```

## 架构

```
🎮 按钮（插件客户端 bundle：一枚按钮 + 一个 iframe）
  └─ <iframe src="/api/dsh-ai-arcade/play">
        └─ 游戏页面（宿主路由，每次现读磁盘，no-store）
              └─ fetch /api/dsh-ai-arcade/brain
                    └─ ctx.llm.stream()  ← 凭证留在主进程
```

**游戏本体为什么不在插件的客户端 bundle 里**：DSH 把所有插件的浏览器半边聚合成一个响应，带一年 `immutable` 强缓存，服务端也缓存这份聚合；改客户端代码必须重启 DSH。把游戏放到宿主路由提供的页面上（`no-store`）之后，改玩法只要刷新页面 —— 这个插件在加入象棋、暂停功能的整个过程中没有重启过。

反过来，插件那一半只当"壳"，几乎不需要改。

### 操作模式

- **双脑贪吃蛇**：单步（点一次走一格、听 AI 的理由）／实时对战（两条蛇自己打）／我来玩（方向键操控蓝蛇）
- **中国象棋**：人机对弈（你执红）／AI 对弈（看它自己下）；难度滑杆 1–10，同时调搜索深度与"失误率"
- 两个游戏都有 **⏸ 暂停**（快捷键 `P`）

## 开发

```sh
npm run build        # esbuild 打包客户端壳与游戏页面（需 Node 22+）
npm test             # 38 项打包自检 + 14 项象棋引擎测试
```

改游戏只需重新构建页面并覆盖 `lib/play.html`，然后刷新浏览器；改服务端或壳需要重启 DSH。

## 测试覆盖

`node --test test/xiangqi.test.mjs` —— 14 项，包括：

- **开局着法数 44**（中国象棋标准值），逐子分解断言（车 4 + 马 4 + 相 4 + 仕 2 + 帅 1 + 兵 5 + 炮 24）
- 马腿、象眼、象不过河、炮必须有炮架才能吃、兵过河才能横走
- 将帅照面视为将军、被将军时只能走应将着法、make/undo 往返一致
- 识别双车错将死、搜索能白吃车、能认出一手绝杀
- 难度滑杆：10 级 20/20 选最优，1 级会失手

## License

MIT
